notes.title: ☀️ Summer Splash Event starts now! Limited-time Challenges & Rewards!! ☀️
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/b711c0d009c851d9fd3f8cbb60a4357aebf2adae.png[/img]

Hello Tricksters!

Feel the heat? It's that time of year when we head over to Isle del Trickster for our holiday getaway!
The Summer Splash event will be available from now until [b]September 1st[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/c3cd620b83aa75f4647c1780c719dc243c68e250.png[/img]

Summer Splash includes [b]24 limited-time challenges[/b] and [b]31 exclusive cosmetics![/b] Some challenges will reward you with Summer Shells that can be exchanged for cosmetics, while others grant exclusive items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/9bdfc77e645ea827778109e560abfc564fc4b79d.png[/img]

If you need help with a challenge don't hesitate to make use of the [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb][b]Trivia Tricks Discord![/b][/url] As always, all of the cosmetics from previous years have returned, so grab them while you can!

Like what we’re doing? Hit the thumbs up below this news post! Have more detailed thoughts? Consider leaving a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404090/Trivia_Tricks/][b]Steam Review[/b][/url] letting us know what you think. Have a great idea you want to see implemented? Come chat with us devs in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb][b]Official Discord![/b][/url] Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/299716c0a1293be7d6766f49f73d35b5449d3528.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The Summer Splash event is back! From now until September 1st complete limited-time challenges to unlock exclusive items!
[*] The Isle del Trickster stage has been made the default stage for the duration of the event!
[*] All 24 challenges and 31 cosmetics from the previous years have returned. Grab them while you can!
[*] For the duration of the Summer event, bosses will also be dressed for the occasion!
[*] Friend Pass players can earn progress towards missions, but only owners of the full game can redeem mission rewards.
[/list]

notes.title: 📹 Animated GIF Support for Workshop is OUT NOW! 📹
notes.content:
Hello Tricksters!

[b]Today's update to Trivia Tricks brings animated GIF support to the user-created question packs that are delivered through the Steam Workshop![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5hSC3C7.gif[/img]

Linking to GIFs is the same as any other image question, meaning creating “video” questions couldn't possibly be easier!

If you're looking for the perfect category to compliment your next trivia night then do check out the fantastic content players have been creating [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1404090/workshop/]in the Steam Workshop.[/url][/b] Interested in creating a pack yourself? [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2662834437]The Official Creator Guide[/url][/b] will help you get started (anyone can do it)!

We cannot wait to see what sort of packs our community will create with GIF support! To celebrate, Trivia Tricks is on sale with a historic post-launch discount. This is an awesome time to upgrade from Friend Pass to the full game, or to gift the game to a friend and support future development!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404090/Trivia_Tricks/
Finally, do consider leaving an honest [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404090/Trivia_Tricks/]Steam Review[/url][/b] letting us know what you think about the game. This helps Trivia Tricks to find more quiz heads on Steam. Thank you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/3e7adf940a529f1ac2edf2b71963355edeabba87.png[/img]
[list][*] Added support for GIF, MP4, and WebP formats for Steam Workshop packs. 
[*] When creating or updating a Workshop pack, Trivia Tricks will now validate that all images in the pack can load and that they are under 5MB in size. This will help creators find problematic images in their packs. 
[*] Games will now start faster, as Trivia Tricks no longer needs to download all images that will be used in that game before it begins. 
[*] The thumbnails for Workshop packs in the Categories Menu now download significantly faster. 
[*] Fixed an issue where creating new Workshop Packs could result in the creation of several identical packs.
[*] Fixed a bug where the notification suggesting that players using the mouse should instead use the WASD keys would not always appear when it should with certain combinations of local players, or would dismiss before the player had answered with the WASD keys.
[*] Fixed an issue where MP4s would pause on the first frame for several seconds when they were first loaded in the Workshop Preview menu.[/list]

notes.title: 🍏 Trivia Tricks launches on macOS with cross-play! + Workshop GIF Preview! 🎥
notes.content:
Hello Tricksters!

Get ready to connect with a whole new group of players! [b]Today, Trivia Tricks launches on macOS with full cross-play support![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/22313d67373cabdbc81c99aa91bd21fa7729daab.png[/img]

A native Mac version of both Trivia Tricks and the Trivia Tricks Friend Pass are now available for download on Steam! The Mac release includes all the features you would expect from Trivia Tricks, including custom Workshop packs and Twitch Integration. 

It doesn't matter if your friends are on Mac, Windows or Linux (including Steam Deck) as everyone can now play Trivia Tricks together seamlessly. [b]This includes full cross-play support for Friend Pass,[/b] bringing more friends together for free!

We’re continuing to investigate the possibility of getting Trivia Tricks ported to more platforms, so stay tuned! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gcvzygH.gif[/img]
We're also excited to announce our next update, launching on May 23rd, which will bring a much-requested feature to Workshop packs... support for animated GIFs!

[b]From today, you can start adding GIFs to your custom question packs to see how they look using the Workshop Preview menu.[/b] We still have some optimization to do before they can be used in-game, so these packs can't be uploaded until May 23rd, but you can start creating yours in preparation for the big day!

We can't wait to see what you'll create!

Do consider leaving an honest [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404090/Trivia_Tricks/]Steam Review[/url][/b] letting us know what you think about the game. This helps Trivia Tricks to find more quiz heads on Steam. Thanks for all your support!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/3e7adf940a529f1ac2edf2b71963355edeabba87.png[/img]
[list][*] Trivia Tricks and Trivia Tricks Friend Pass are now available on macOS!
[*] Mac users can play with Windows and Linux users with seamless cross-play. This includes cross-platform Friend Pass!
[*] Trivia Tricks is compatible with Apple Silicon devices, all the way back to the Apple M1 from 2020!
[*] Added support for GIFs, MP4s and WebPs in the Workshop Preview menu, although they cannot be uploaded yet.
[*] Start creating your packs today ready for launch on the 23rd!
[*] Updated the ExampleWorkshop file to a version that contains an example of an animated question.
[*] Added a handful of new questions to the base game categories.
[*] Fixed an issue where the 'Start' button wouldn't open the menu on Steam Deck and Linux.
[*] Fixed an issue where, when a game is beginning and the download of Workshop packs was cancelled, any local players would incorrectly have their state set to 'unready'.
[*] Fixed an issue where the 'default resolutions' we load in the options menu (720p, 1080p, etc) weren't always available.
[*] Improved clarity on some of the written instructions in the Twitch Integration menus.
[*] Improved clarity on the written instructions telling players to use a keyboard rather than a mouse if other players can see their answers (Twitch, local or remote play). This instruction will now only dismiss once the player has used the keyboard.
[*] Fixed some typos and cleaned up the wording on a variety of questions. Thanks to all of you who took the time to report these to us directly!
[*] Placed 2025 copyright on the title screen (for real this time!!)
[/list]

notes.title: 🔮 Item Tweaks & Bug Fixes! 🐛
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/86363ea61dcae681ad236076090578660bdf78e1.png[/img]

Hey Tricksters!

Trivia Tricks' 63rd regular update goes live today, containing quality-of-life improvements across several areas of the game!

Look forward to our next release, which will update every category with new questions, relevant to the events of 2024.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/cdc7a5ddc0c18eb362b811a2246de836f47c8024.png[/img][list]
[*] AI players will now decide whether to use items earlier in the round to ensure items such as the Crystal Ball are used correctly and mirror human behaviour.
[*] AI players will be more likely to use their items the longer they hold them for. This will make games with AI players more interesting with more happening during the game.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/fe2664cdf83f705cf53603684703ad8a1370b150.png[/img][list]
[*] The ready timer will no longer begin counting down if the host hasn't readied up. This stops games from accidentally starting while the host is still changing settings.
[*] Improved the uniqueness of item spawns during Chance Round to diversify which items are seen during a game.
[*] Added text under the 'Visible Answers' and 'Change Answer' options in the lobby to better explain their usage.
[*] In the Character Creator, the ‘Save Character’ menu has been renamed to ‘Overwrite who’ for extra clarity.
[*] Improved the wording and ordering for the Windowed settings in the Settings Menu to better promote 'Borderless Fullscreen', and describe 'Exclusive Fullscreen'.
[*] The Space and Summer stages have been optimized slightly to fix performance hitches.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/9ec74010f65e13fd3fdb49021ca13388a14d81c7.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur if the player entered a gamepad input on a certain frame while joining an online game.
[*] Fixed the Golden Pants' sparkle not sparkling enough!
[*] Fixed a visual error in the Twitch Latency menu.
[*] Fixed a visual error displaying a placeholder question on the TV when joining a game.
[*] Fixed the Tab Menu not respecting the player's aspect ratio correctly.
[*] Tweaks to a few of Mr. Tricks’ lines after Chance Round has finished.
[/list]
Again - thank you for all your continued support! Please consider leaving an honest [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404090/Trivia_Tricks/]Steam Review[/url][/b] letting us know what you think about the game. This helps Trivia Tricks to find more quiz heads on Steam. Thank you!

notes.title: 🚀🌌 Get Ready for Launch! Trivia Tricks v1.0 is Here! 🌕🌠
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QnKx97V.gif[/img]

Tricksters, get ready for takeoff!

Trivia Tricks is graduating from Early Access and we're launching into version 1.0 with some shiny new features! Let's check them out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/7385283d1794a9e6e5d4c087c35d77bd859a8d83.png[/img]

Fitting the 'launch' theme, how about a brand new [b]Space Stage[/b]!?
Take to the stars, land on a moon and do a little trivia. Very casual!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/fde0f493de002307f1f25ef4898589d3fa305975.png[/img]

How about some new challenges? 
Complete [b]SEVEN new achievements[/b] and receive brand new cosmetics for your efforts!
Hop to it and get that Froggy Hat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/6a2e50d9919aaee728e2124a18e0c86e465f04df.png[/img]

Setting up Twitch Integration just got easier! Use the new [b]'Connection Test'[/b] feature to measure the length of your stream delay so you can set your Answering Time to a pace that works for your community! When playing with Twitch every question lasts the full Answering Time, so this will help keep the game moving!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/3e7bca48a574b82ac4c92c920d981dbed91d4b27.png[/img]

Not naming names, but some players fail to notice the option to join Chance Round. Oops! A little embarrassing but we've got them covered! The prompt to opt in or out is now shown front and center. Surely there's no more excuses for skipping Chance Round now, right?... RIGHT??

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/dbb6806d04ae9930ce017099d450b7a6cb508dfa.png[/img]

This update brings over 200 more questions to the base game, including picture questions in the Geography and Art & Literature categories!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/9fbe31ac792da31c76c9506217a1b594c7245e3e.png[/img]

Trivia Tricks has received constant improvements for 4 years and we have met all of our Early Access milestones – and then some! We're proud of what we've achieved in that time and we’re thrilled with the positive player reception we’ve received. Now felt like the right time to lift the Early Access label.

But this doesn't mean we're done! We're committed to supporting Trivia Tricks for as long as possible. We're already preparing our Question Database for '2024 in Trivia' alongside reviewing the possibility of bringing Trivia Tricks to other platforms. If you have a killer-feature you'd want to see added join the [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Official Discord[/url][/b] and let us know!

Here are the full patch notes for this update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/7999b9870e626051fe6ffa3d7dbab5872c32d418.png[/img]
[list]
[*] To celebrate the launch of Trivia Tricks, a new stage has been added! Where? [i]In Space![/i]
[*] Enjoy the new music which accompanies the Space Stage!
[*] The 'Frequent Flyer' achievement has been updated to require the Space stage to be played at least once (if you have already unlocked 'Frequent Flyer', then you will keep the achievement).
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/30e53c15a7b790222707b4662e01de61390eb76f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Seven new achievements have been added, each with their own unlockable cosmetic! Can you unlock them all?
[*] This includes the ultimate challenge ‘Gilded Genius’, which unlocks the coveted 'Golden Pants'.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/fc406e3226619bd083ab1d0e2644226623997a1b.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Over 200 new questions have been added!
[*] Picture questions have been added to the Geography and Art & Literature base game categories!
[*] Fixed some typos and cleaned up the wording on a variety of questions. Thanks to all of you who took the time to report these to us directly!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/8f613c81ac29ab84a45e795fa9e15e6099dc31dd.png[/img]
[list]
[*] A new tool has been added for streamers to test their connections and to measure their exact stream delay.
[*] Based on the measured stream delay, Trivia Tricks will suggest an appropriate Answering Time! This is useful as, when playing with Twitch, every question lasts the full selected answering length.
[*] Several bug fixes and UI improvements have been made to the Twitch menus.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/fe2664cdf83f705cf53603684703ad8a1370b150.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The ordering in the Character Creator has been updated. Any unlocked cosmetics will now appear at the start of the list, with locked cosmetics being at the end.
[*] Workshop pack visibility can now be set to ‘Unlisted’ when packs are being created or updated.
[*] The notification that appears when restarting a lobby now clearly states that the restart will occur after the current question or Chance Round has finished.
[*] The ‘Tame’ Chance Round setting has been renamed to ‘No Items’ to clearly convey what the setting adjusts.
[*] To improve loading times in the Workshop Statistics menu the rating information is now placed behind a confirmation.
[*] Removed the "Trying to add players?" message that would appear in the lobby when using a different control method than originally connected in the Character Select screen.
[*] Added in a specific error message when trying to preview, create or update a Workshop file that ends in a “)” character.
[*] Menus across Trivia Tricks have been updated and standardized to use our latest UI elements.
[*] Now that pants are no longer “coming soon”, we’ve updated the posters that are visible in the Character Creator!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/9ec74010f65e13fd3fdb49021ca13388a14d81c7.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where a client leaving the lobby at the ‘Caching’ step would cause the caching to never complete, meaning hosts would have to close and recreate the lobby.
[*] Fixed a bug where, if a player cancelled downloading picture questions, after the game reloaded the lobby music wouldn’t play.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Update menu would only display a maximum of 50 Workshop packs.
[*] Fixed some character dialogue issues where characters would quickly change their portrait after they began speaking, and better synchronized animations to the on-screen text.
[*] Fixed a bug where the image of a picture question would sometimes appear in the middle of the screen for a single frame after the answer had been revealed.
[*] Fixed a bug where, when the images of picture questions were being downloaded, the progress bars that show download progress would only say "Complete!" when all players had finished their downloads.
[*] Fixed a bug where the last player to ready up wouldn't be shown as ‘ready’ while Workshop packs load.
[*] Fixed a bug where, if a player joined during the intro, the game would tell the player that they will join after the host is finished downloading picture questions, even if the host wasn't downloading picture questions.
[*] Fixed a bug where, when joining a game during “Question 1”, the screen would say players are currently answering "Question 0”.
[*] Fixed an issue where the 'Trending Workshop' carousel on the Main Menu would change its size as it was being navigated.
[*] Fixed some of the lobby setting tick boxes having an incorrect aspect ratio.
[*] Fixed some missing sound effects in the Workshop and Character Creator menus.
[*] Fixed a bug where the blur behind the Pause menu wouldn’t always cover everything on the screen.
[*] Fixed a bug where the “Speed Bonus is turned off when playing with Twitch” notification would appear during the picture question consent screen, as opposed to during Mr. Tricks’ intro.
[*] Fixed a bug where client player answers weren’t hidden when playing with Twitch for specific question types.
[*] Fixed a bug where, if a player who was not the host used the Crystal Ball item, they wouldn't be able to see other player answers unless another player answered after they used the Crystal Ball.
[*] Fixed a bug where Mr. Tricks would lose his Lei during the Summer Splash event if someone joined midgame.
[*] Fixed an issue where Tricksters wearing the Flamingo Floatie could sit in certain positions on the Main Menu that would cause the Floatie to clip through their head.
[/list]
Thank you for all your continued support! Please consider leaving an honest [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404090/Trivia_Tricks/]Steam Review[/url][/b] letting us know what you think about the game. This helps Trivia Tricks to find more quiz heads on Steam. Thank you!

notes.title: Picture Questions OUT NOW for ALL! 🖼️ + Workshop Question Pack Ratings! 📊
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/dc72cfc569ca5d0286a0a4fb62e80fb74e357ea7.png[/img]

Hello everyone!
[b]Today we have released Workshop V2 to everyone! [/b]We'd like to thank everyone who took part in the Beta for helping us check its stability and squash a few bugs. 

If you need a reminder of what new features are possible with Workshop V2 then here's a quick run down:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/1d7364fd704928cc3b630883f4b2253e2302fb0b.png[/img]

[b]You can now use images when creating questions![/b] This feature massively expands the possibilities for creating questions! Whether it's as simple as naming an actor or solving a complex mathematical formula, the possibilities have been expanded significantly! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/299654c0674157fbed10c10d3c8b03c932d839c9.png[/img]

[b]Adding an Answer Explanation after the correct answer is revealed[/b] is a great way to give greater context to why players may have been tripped up. You can also use this section for sharing interesting facts or force people to read an awful pun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/bf83366220ca023c9ca4f101014ef3bba7481181.png[/img]

By allowing questions to [b]contain less than 4 answers[/b] you now have the possibility to create True or False style questions. Having fewer options can make a question easier or harder! It's also handy if you can't quite think of 4 answers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/6ac57f7ab6abc45e03670a6ee29b15cd565eb68d.png[/img]

Another feature coming with this update is [b]Workshop Ratings![/b] The community review score of packs has been made visible to help players find great Workshop packs to play with. If a pack has received 5 or more ratings then its review score is now displayed in-game. If a pack has a positive rating of 85% or higher then it will gain a larger symbol! You can also see the like-to-dislike ratio when browsing Workshop packs in the Categories Menu. This feature should connect players with great question packs and help creators with discoverability.

If your pack is not quite where you'd like it to be ratings-wise then we've got you covered. Since we've written a ton of base game questions, we’ve learned a thing or two about writing quality trivia! To help boost your ratings we've written this handy Steam guide with tips and tricks for creating engaging questions. [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3293824955&preview=true]Check out the guide here![/url][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/aede753163982707f2534d1fa34d6d225b730e68.png[/img]

Lastly, we've made some UI changes to the lobby menu. Switching between game modes has now been changed to buttons. Hopefully this makes it a bit more obvious you can change the game mode to Co-Op! [b]Clients can also click on these buttons to let the lobby host know you'd like to switch game mode.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/3625a0239b3b4723c062783d0983ff0b945f5964.png[/img]

Similarly, did you know clients can click on categories to request the host to turn them on or off? If clients do this now then [b]the category background will change colors to help the host keep track of which categories players want to adjust![/b]

Once again, thank you to everyone who took part in the Beta to help get this feature up and running! We hope you enjoy the massively expanded Workshop and can't wait to see what creative packs you’re all cooking up!

Here's a full run down of changes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/d08c6d549c738c4fcf2729e19ac141a57dcb69ff.png[/img]
[list]
[*] It is now possible to view the community review score of Workshop packs within Trivia Tricks!
[*] Packs that have a rating of 85% or above are marked with a larger icon.
[*] The community review score of a pack will not be displayed until it has at least 5 ratings.
[*] The number of questions from a pack that are required to have been seen before being prompted to rate it has been lowered from 10 to 5.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/fe2664cdf83f705cf53603684703ad8a1370b150.png[/img]
[list]
[*] When clients suggest a pack to turn on/off in the Categories Menu, the selected category will now change color.
[*] The method in which players change game modes between Standard and Co-Op now uses buttons instead.
[*] Clients can now request what game mode they would like to play in a similar fashion to how they can suggest categories.
[*] The "Most Likes" option in the Workshop Browse Menu has been removed. As this option would sort by total “like” count we felt this would cause confusion with the shown review percentage.
[*] Added the option to filter the Workshop Browse menu to the last 2 weeks of activity. This has also been set as the default, as opposed to 1 week.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Bits that were thrown by Twitch characters wouldn't despawn correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could request to play locked categories.
[*] Fixed an issue where the error messages for Picture Questions would sometimes flicker.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could suggest Workshop categories during Vs Boss Mode.
[*] Fixed a bug where, if the Categories Menu failed to search for Workshop packs, players would have to leave and recreate the lobby to try the search again.
[/list]

Thank you for all your feedback during the beta! Like what we’re doing? Hit the thumbs up below this news post! Have more detailed thoughts? Consider leaving a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404090/Trivia_Tricks/][b]Steam Review[/b][/url] letting us know what you think. Have a great idea you want to see implemented? Come chat with us devs in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb][b]Official Discord![/b][/url] Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

notes.title: Workshop V2 Beta Hotfixes Wave 1 (Version 0.9.48.3)
notes.content:
Hello Tricksters! Thanks for all your feedback from these first days of the Workshop V2 Beta! This hotfix addresses some of issues that the community have brought to our attention so far! If you've missed the big news, we're running a beta for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1404090/view/4184488070312331424][b]new Workshop features including picture questions![/b][/url]

This hotfix addresses the following issues...
[list]
[*] When player answers are revealed, the camera position and on-screen location of the picture have been adjusted so they no longer cover the player nametags.
[*] Added a new validation step on pack upload that ensures all links in the imageURL column must end in .jpg, .jpeg or .png

[*] Fixed an issue where, if an image from a Workshop pack couldn't be downloaded, the game wouldn't start and players would have to press to cancel and retry.
[*] Fixed a bug where, when the player answers were revealed, if the image had failed to download the area of the screen that would display the image would just say “ERROR”
[*] Fixed a bug where, if the same image was used in multiple questions and the first appearance of this image failed to download, the player was unable to retry the download of the later questions which use that image.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player would be unable to interact with the lobby if they clicked Back during the Workshop Download phase.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player would be unable to interact with the lobby if the Workshop Verification step failed.
[*] Fixed a bug where the ‘Reload Image’ button appeared in Ganymede's Lab, despite serving no purpose.
[/list]

notes.title: PREPARE Your Workshop Picture Questions TODAY! 📸
notes.content:
Hello Tricksters!

It’s been a while, but that’s because we’ve been hard at work preparing for the full launch of Trivia Tricks, and we have some exciting news to share! [b]With today’s update, it’s now possible to begin preparing ‘V2’ Workshop packs ready for the big day![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/1c8b594c721d2e1031dcd9002dc35cba929237d8.png[/img]

V2 Workshop packs heavily extend the possibilities of player created question packs by offering...
[list][*] Picture questions! Include an image that will be shown alongside your question.
[*] The ability to have just 2 or 3 answer choices instead of 4.
[*] Answer explanations, a piece of text which can be displayed to players after the answer is revealed.
[/list]We are proud to empower our Workshop creators to enjoy the same feature set as the questions that ship with the game. [i]V2 packs can’t be uploaded just yet[/i] but you can start creating a Workshop pack with these features and preview how they will look in-game!

Simply:
[olist][*] Select [b]‘Manage Workshop’[/b] on the main menu to open Ganymede’s Lab (this creates the example file)
[*] Navigate your computer to [b]Documents/TriviaTricks/Workshop/ExampleWorkshopV2Beta[/b]
[*] There you’ll find the new [b]ExampleWorkshopV2Beta.csv[/b] file, which will show you examples of how to use all of these new features in a question pack
[/olist]If you need a hand with getting to grips with Workshop V2 then please consider joining the official [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb][b]Trivia Tricks Discord,[/b][/url] we’re more than happy to help! We don’t have a date for the full launch just yet; we’re still preparing the finishing touches, but consider following [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404090/Trivia_Tricks/]Trivia Tricks on Steam[/url][/b] to be the first to know when these features will be available in Trivia Tricks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/071f3813d508038b60a9051f7d6c904d1e9eab38.png[/img]

Of course, with great power comes great responsibility. We’ve been looking at how to ensure players only see the content that they’ve consented to see. Therefore, we've created a confirmation screen before any games with Workshop picture questions begin.

This feature allows players to view the domain that hosts the image, alongside giving a thumbnail preview of the pictures before they appear during gameplay. This way you can check for content suitability beforehand, preventing inappropriate images showing during streams. Let us know what you think!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/2ebd578f9e22a6ef7da083bfd02f88cf4d9d41fb.png[/img]

We’ve also been adding picture questions for the base game’s Geography and Art categories. These will be launching alongside the full game! In the immediate future, [b]we’ll be releasing an update that will feature a mass of new relevant-for-2024 questions for the categories in the base game.[/b] Stay tuned for more information on that!

If you'd like to help shape the future of Trivia Tricks then please consider leaving an honest [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404090/Trivia_Tricks/]Steam Review[/url][/b] letting us know what you think about the game. notes.title: ❄️ Rare Trivia Snowdown cosmetics! + Announcing PICTURE QUESTIONS! 📸
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/44f28eb474ec98a3a04bc7edd87dbb0fb11764e1.png[/img]

It’s time to bring in the festive cheer, [b]the Trivia Snowdown event is available from now until January 14th![/b] High placement in trivia games will earn you Festive Cookies which can be exchanged for exclusive cosmetics. Plus, the limited-time Festive Category is back with a 2023 revamp, alongside the return of the Krampus & Santa boss battle! Have you been naughty or nice this year?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/4436210d39a2738ece24532303d7be0d4bcd02c4.png[/img]

The new cosmetic additions in this year’s event are the [b]Pudding Hat, Snowman Body, Ice Dress, Tinsel Accessory, Mistletoe, and Winter Scarf![/b] Don’t miss your chance to get them before the event is over! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/bf5a4f09b60ee73a27ebb10d9a9b71cc5e00092e.png[/img]

Additionally, the Winter stage has had a visual overhaul with slow falling snow, remodelled cabins and a new skybox featuring the aurora borealis - localized entirely within the Trivia Tricks studio!

From all of us in the Trivia Tricks team, happy holidays, and thank you for another year of support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/34023c0a1299041f5182e221c9916e2e2ef331be.png[/img]

We’re pleased to announce our final Early Access feature – [b]picture questions are coming to Trivia Tricks, including support for player-created picture questions in Workshop Packs!![/b] 📸📸📸 We’ll be making a follow-up post with more details soon. Do consider [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404090/Trivia_Tricks/][b]pressing the button to “Follow” us on Steam[/b][/url] so you can be the first to know all the details on picture questions, including insights on how to create them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/df22758d08f3dd26b2ccd453ac2a9b6a1140a351.png[/img]

Trivia Tricks is proud to be built using Unreal Engine, and today’s update [b]brings Trivia Tricks from Unreal Engine 4 to the latest version of Unreal Engine 5.[/b] This was not a simple task, but because we aim to support Trivia Tricks into the future it is necessary to use future technology!

As part of this change Trivia Tricks now supports DirectX 12 in addition to DirectX 11 and you’ll be presented with either option at startup. DirectX 12 will provide a better experience if your computer is modern enough to handle it, but we will continue to support DirectX 11 as a commitment to users on our minimum requirements for as long as it is possible to do so.

If you'd like to help shape the future of Trivia Tricks then please consider leaving an honest [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404090/Trivia_Tricks/]Steam Review[/url][/b] letting us know what you think about the game. This will guide the direction of future updates and helps Trivia Tricks to find more quiz heads on Steam! Thank you!

Without further ado, here’s the patch notes in full!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/f0d193984f82b44184dff505d34053e98515eb47.png[/img]
[list][*] Play games to earn Cookies! Use these Cookies to unlock Festive cosmetics in the Character Creator!
[*] Spend those Cookies on the new-for-2023 Pudding Hat, Snowman Body, Ice Dress, Tinsel Accessory, Mistletoe, and Winter Scarf!
[*] Plus, the challenges and cosmetics from the previous events are also available; check them out in the Character Creator!
[*] The winter stage has been updated! Featuring falling snow, the Northern lights, and updated textures and models!
[*] The Festive category returns with questions relevant for 2023, including questions with only 2 answers, using a ‘True or False’ format!
[*] Question Explanations are also available for the relevant Festive category questions!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/e82ee33bdd45b9c1c5fde0113bea6e024a667d0b.png[/img]
[list][*] In order to support upcoming features, Trivia Tricks now uses Unreal Engine 5!
[*] DirectX 12 and DirectX 11 are now offered as options when you launch Trivia Tricks on Steam.
[*] In DirectX 12 a shader compilation step has been added after the title screen, which avoids stutters when new visual effects are encountered. (#StutterStruggle)
[*] The physics on cosmetics have been improved to be much more responsive.
[*] Modern hardware will see several improvements to lighting, loading and other engine-related features.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/72c0ce4dd0b54e2a02d9a237bb3f0ee3d34c5487.png[/img]
[list][*] Fixed bosses sometimes displaying the wrong name on their podium in the lobby.
[*] Fixed the appearance of some UI elements in the Character Creator.
[*] Fixed the Featured Workshop UI element on the Main Menu drastically changing size when navigated.
[*] Fixed the Featured Workshop UI element on the Main Menu sometimes getting controller focus over the ‘Play’ button.
[*] A few UI elements that would only accept input when lifting the left mouse button have been adjusted to immediately respond on initial click.
[*] Added more questions in several categories.
[*] Fixed some typos and cleaned up the wording on a variety of questions, alongside updating several questions to be accurate following developments in the modern day.
[*] Steam Deck and Linux now use Proton 8 by default, resolving an issue that began a few days ago where Trivia Tricks would crash on launch in Proton 7.
[*] The Friend Pass version of Trivia Tricks is now Steam Deck verified! In addition, an issue where Friend Pass players on Steam Deck or Linux couldn't see the host's subscribed Workshop packs in the categories menu has been fixed.
[*] Potentially resolved cases of camera ‘judder’ on panning motions during gameplay.
[/list]Like what we’re doing? Hit the thumbs up below this news post! Have more detailed thoughts? Consider leaving a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404090/Trivia_Tricks/][b]Steam Review[/b][/url] letting us know what you think. Have a great idea you want to see implemented? Come chat with us devs in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb][b]Official Discord![/b][/url] Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

notes.title: Consider Trivia Tricks for Labor of Love!
notes.content:
Hello Tricksters! For the first time ever we're making the case that [b]Trivia Tricks deserves your nomination for 'Labor of Love'![/b] We'll keep our justification short!
[list][*] Trivia Tricks has been receiving updates for 3 years and [b]all promised Early Access milestones have been delivered![/b] (Co-Op Vs Boss, Twitch Integration and Workshop Community Packs)

[*] We're active in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2FsUwKvCb][b]our Discord,[/b][/url] and player feedback leads to direct changes in the game.

[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/3ce60d735ec948a0c86e9f54c4a0a1bb865abe3c.png[/img]
We would be humbled if you would consider nominating Trivia Tricks for Labor of Love in the Steam Awards. Here's to many more updates in future! Thank you from the 3-Tricks team!

notes.title: TRUE OR FALSE: Has the Halloween event returned? TRUE!! ✔️
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/9fc534cf96655054abc7f9ed2f9dbe06434b4131.png[/img]

Hello Tricksters!

[b]It’s time for the annual Trivia Tricks Spook-aversary event,[/b] where we come together to experience the collective fear of Halloween [i]and[/i] the march of time. This Spook-aversary marks the third year of Trivia Tricks’ active development and today we bring you a whole new type of question!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/dbf7fa6c08df989d536c64b1c3109e3d2ab284c2.png[/img]

Trivia Tricks questions no longer require 4 answers, [b]meaning question formats like “True or False” are now possible![/b] Alongside Question Explanations [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1404090/view/3712711277286839095][b](introduced in the last update)[/b][/url] this forms another part of our final Early Access milestone to make new question types possible in Trivia Tricks. The limited-time Halloween category features a number of ‘True or False’ questions and you’ll see them in our other categories soon!

Like Question Explanations, [b]questions with 2 or 3 answers will be made available for user-created Workshop packs in a future update.[/b] We have one more question type in active development that will be announced soon, so be sure to follow Trivia Tricks to be the first to know... (📸)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/19c6ba68e8e64f48ab77cd9bd0378486da340b81.png[/img]

Trivia Tricks’ seasonal events always come with new cosmetics to earn! This year you’ll find a [b]Mimic[/b] hat with terrifying animated teeth, [b]Spider Eyes[/b] that put pupils all over your face, a [b]Plague Mask[/b] complete with a long nose, antenna-like [b]Alien Eyes[/b] that stick out your head and a [b]full Robot costume[/b] (made out of cardboard). All of these can be earned through candy that’s earned through regular games!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/089d8920e994c8ec1b3ececf9d00c2068b5de0d5.png[/img]

In addition, the challenge and cosmetics from the previous three Spook-aversary events are also back! If you missed them last time around then you have until [b]November 9th[/b] to make it right!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/bb4baf86759c13fbea0dbbf2ee7529c772dc2a27.png[/img]

[b]The Halloween Stage has had a visual overhaul,[/b] with a new skybox, rustling grass, a haunted-house renovation and ominous rain. Enjoy the new extra-spooky vibe!

Oh, and to top this all off, the limited-time Halloween category has been extended [b]with over 100 new questions[/b] covering both Halloween history and the latest in horror media. So stop hiding behind the sofa and get quizzing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/5e5969bb9475dd7f6e92088aa4e85dcd91dafb13.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Play games to get candy! Use this candy to unlock Halloween cosmetics in the Character Creator!
[*] Spend that candy on the new-for-2023 Mimic Hat, Spider Eyes, Plague Mask, Alien Eyes, Robot Head and Robot Body!
[*] Plus, the challenges and cosmetics from the previous three events are also available, check them out in the Character Creator!
[*] The Halloween stage has been updated! Featuring a new vibrancy and bespoke visual effects!
[*] The Halloween category returns with around 100 new questions!
[*] The Halloween category now contains some questions with only 2 answers, using a ‘True or False’ format!
[*] Explanations are also available for the relevant Halloween category questions!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/fe2664cdf83f705cf53603684703ad8a1370b150.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Some Trivia Tricks questions will now only have 2 or 3 answer options instead of the usual 4!
[*] These new question types will debut in the Halloween category! Keep an eye out for more planned in the other categories in a future update!
[*] In addition, soon you’ll be able to create questions with only 2 or 3 answer options through Steam Workshop!
[*] Some items cannot be used when a question with only 2 or 3 answer options is being asked. This is marked by a warning sign in the player's inventory when this is the case.
[*] Summer's boss battle in both the online and offline modes has been updated to accommodate questions with 2 or 3 answer options.
[*] Fixed a bug where the character selection screen portrait was fuzzy for every character but the first.
[/list]

But first, if you'd like to support Trivia Tricks, then please consider leaving an honest [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404090/Trivia_Tricks/]Steam Review[/url][/b] letting us know what you think about the game. This will help shape the direction of future updates and helps Trivia Tricks to find more quiz heads on Steam! Thank you!

Now, onto the items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/3274d200cd84f2d6475b851a1aefb27bc463444e.png[/img]
Use [b]Double Down[/b] whenever you're certain you know the right answer to earn double points for that question! Get it wrong and you might look a little silly but it's worth a try!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/ea17b683ea3cce26ce0e77dbb589ad44de5edfb1.png[/img]
The [b]Royal Decree[/b] is a rare item that steals a percentage of points from any player of your choosing. It then divides that stolen money equally among the other players! If it looks like someone is pulling away with a lead then you know what to do...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/600bf77b1fe22481ea47f32d413b12bc08f3ba6e.png[/img]
If you're given the [b]Hot Potato[/b] you better answer the question correctly to pass it on, otherwise it’ll explode and you'll lose points! Every time the Hot Potato is passed on, the heat will increase. The hotter it gets the more points it’ll take! Just how hot does it get? You'll have to find out for yourselves!

These new items were designed to nudge Trivia Tricks' game balance into rewarding skilful play and creating tighter games. We hope that after this update you'll notice the scoreboard will be much closer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/a4abc19d3861204466a2035f0ef33d373d659f66.png[/img]
Finally, if you missed the news, we've been releasing updates that focus on QoL improvements and polish, with the intention to prepare Trivia Tricks for its graduation from Early Access! You can see the last two updates [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1404090/view/3678924766335651816]here[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1404090/view/3691310933857960547]here.[/url][/b] Today’s update includes even more polish, which you can find the details of below!

We're looking for inspiration on what to improve in the next patch, so if you want to shape the future of Trivia Tricks' development then consider joining the [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord[/url][/b] and putting your suggestion forward!

Finally, to celebrate the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/33125/Friend_Pass_Party_Bundle/]Friend Pass Party Bundle[/url][/b] the Worm from [b]Last Train Outta’ Wormtown[/b] is now a free hat available to all Trivia Tricks players. [i]Chomp![/i]

Ok, without further delay, onto the full patch notes!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/ab510b67e16af15a0538ff805112cc00a206ae19.png[/img]
[list][*] The [b]Double Down[/b] item has been added! Use this item to receive double points if you answer the current question correctly!
[*] The [b]Royal Decree[/b] item has been added! This rare item allows you to steal a percentage of points from a player (percentage depends on player count) and distribute it between everybody else!
[*] The [b]Hot Potato[/b] has been added! This item is immediately in-play, and you’ll need to answer correctly to pass it onto the next player and add to the heat. The more heat the Hot Potato has built up then the more points that will be lost after someone answers incorrectly, causing it to explode!
[*] Mr. Tricks likes potatoes and will sometimes talk about them!
[*] As always, these items are not included when Chance Round is set to ‘Tame’.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/72c0ce4dd0b54e2a02d9a237bb3f0ee3d34c5487.png[/img]
[list][*] Added the ‘Hungry Worm’ hat, featuring a guest appearance of the Worm from [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2318480/Last_Train_Outta_Wormtown/]Last Train Outta’ Wormtown![/url][/b]
[*] After a question’s answer is revealed the next question’s category will be shown.
[*] Improved the appearance of some menu elements, particularly around the host’s lobby settings.
[*] The ‘streak’ bonus in the lobby menu is no longer harder to click than the other bonus options.
[*] Players that have deactivated the In-Game Chat in the Options Menu will now see a message in their chatbox informing them why they cannot see the chat.
[*] Players that have deactivated the In-Game Chat in the Options Menu will now see messages related to players joining/leaving games, or suggesting changes to the selected categories.
[*] Fixed some typos and cleaned up the wording on a variety of questions. Thanks to all of you who took the time to report these to us directly!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/9ec74010f65e13fd3fdb49021ca13388a14d81c7.png[/img]
[list][*] Fixed a bug in the Character Creator where the description for the ‘Pilot Suit’ wasn’t showing.
[*] Fixed a bug where AI characters with identical outfits to a player character could be spawned.
[*] Fixed a bug where players would continue to play the Crystal Ball animation even after losing the item.
[*] Fixed a few issues related to Twitch connection timeouts.

notes.title: 🎫 Friend Pass Release Date & Important Pricing Info 🎫
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/668885cb1e64635db1bf4d5dca691519575227af.png[/img]

Hello Tricksters! The time has come to share more details on Friend Pass, which will allow you to invite 7 friends into any online lobby through room code, without them needing to purchase Trivia Tricks!

[b]We’re proud to announce that Friend Pass will be available on [strike]June 1st![/strike] (Friend Pass now launches [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1404090/view/3718329995184293824]on May 30th![/url])[/b] Here's a short video trailer we've put together going over the details of joining an online lobby as a free Friend Pass player!

[previewyoutube=lTwKdQaaVfI;full][/previewyoutube]
Any questions? Good! [b]Here's a handy FAQ![/b]

[list]
[*] [h3][b]What is Trivia Tricks Friend Pass?[/b][/h3]
‘Trivia Tricks Friend Pass’ is a free Steam download that will allow anyone to join ‘Trivia Tricks’ games via a room code.

[*] [h3][b]How do I get Friend Pass?[/b][/h3]
Friend Pass will be available to download through Steam, either as a ‘demo’ to Trivia Tricks or as a separate application (details to be finalized).

[*] [h3][b]How many people can play?[/b][/h3]
Up to 7 players can join an online lobby through Friend Pass! Lobbies can mix and match any combination of full game owners, Friend Pass users, and local players.

[*] [h3][b]Do you have to be added as a ‘friend’ on Steam to join the lobby?[/b][/h3]
Nope! Friend Pass players can join any lobby once they know the room code! Handy for streamers!

[*] [h3][b]Is there a playtime limit?[/b][/h3]
Nope! Friend Pass players can play as much as they like!

[*] [h3][b]Is this a limited time event?[/b][/h3]
Nope! Friend Pass is a permanent addition to Trivia Tricks!

[*] [h3][b]Are there any limits to Friend Pass?[/b][/h3]
Friend Pass players will not be able to host games, but after joining an online lobby through a room code they will be able to play with the same settings as full game owners. This includes Workshop packs, Co-Op Vs Boss mode, and partaking in games with Twitch Chat!

Friend Pass players cannot create their own characters or unlock achievements. If a Friend Pass player later decides to purchase the full game then any progress made in Friend Pass will carry over into the full game. This includes cosmetics, statistics and achievements (any earned achievements will unlock on Steam as soon as the full game is loaded).

Do note, because of the way Steam separates play time between full games and demos, Steam Trading Card drops (available soon) will only be available when playing the full game.

[*] [h3][b]What will happen to Steam Remote Play?[/b][/h3]
Trivia Tricks will continue to support Steam Remote Play as a way to join friends or connect extra controllers. However, we’ve had feedback from players that we should simplify the experience of sharing Trivia Tricks with others - we will therefore be removing the references to Steam Remote Play from Trivia Tricks’ How to Play menus. Remote Play will continue to work as it does today and improve with Valve’s updates to the service.

[*] [h3][b]Will the release of Friend Pass be the final Early Access update?[/b][/h3]
Friend Pass is the final major milestone that we will be releasing in Early Access, but we have some extra features and polish planned before Trivia Tricks graduates into full release!

And once Trivia Tricks hits launch day the updates won't stop! More updates are planned for Trivia Tricks even after launch, so stay tuned for more exciting news!

[*] [h3][b]My question isn’t answered here![/b][/h3]
That’s not a question!... But that’s fine! Join the Trivia Tricks [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb][b]Discord[/b][/url] to ask your question to the development team directly!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/fd9dd2e889701f717ecaa9dd0a2c59cb5044167e.png[/img]

Throughout the span of two and a half years Trivia Tricks has received a frequent stream of content updates including Co-Op Vs Boss Mode, Seasonal Events and Steam Workshop Support while remaining at the same price. This pricing was chosen to reward players who put their trust in us to deliver our Early Access promises, and to thank those who have offered their invaluable feedback during development.

Trivia Tricks now represents more value than it did in 2020 and with the launch of Friend Pass the price of the full game will increase to be in-line with this added value. Once Friend Pass becomes available on [strike]June 1st![/strike] [b](Friend Pass now launches [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1404090/view/3718329995184293824]on May 30th![/url])[/b], [b]Trivia Tricks will be priced at $14.99 / £12.79 / €14.79.[/b] This will be the base price of Trivia Tricks upon leaving Early Access too.

We would like to thank all our fans who have supported us during Early Access, without you Trivia Tricks would not have been possible! If you’re interested in hosting Trivia Tricks lobbies or creating your own custom characters then Trivia Tricks’ current price is the cheapest that it will be available for the foreseeable future. Don’t miss it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/50d3c2b8898b0fb3a0708bef6de1cd11d35c40fd.png[/img]

The character selection screen has been altered to give you a more streamlined process getting into games! You will now be prompted to select how many players are using the same device to play. Once confirmed you'll be given the appropriate number of slots to select your characters! This should clear up some confusion around the correct place to add local players. For most players this is simply an extra button click and then proceeding as normal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/ee1476d747cc3db56f87d745447064ed542b25aa.gif[/img]

As always, if you like what we’re doing, please hit the thumbs up below this news post! If you have more detailed thoughts then do consider leaving a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404090/Trivia_Tricks/][b]Steam Review[/b][/url] letting us know what you think - they really help us out! 

If you want to reach out to us developers then we can always be found in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb][b]Discord.[/b][/url] Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

notes.title: Announcing 🎟️ FRIEND PASS + EVERYTHING IS BETTER! 🎉
notes.content:
Hello all! Let’s get to the big news...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/668885cb1e64635db1bf4d5dca691519575227af.png[/img]

We’re proud to announce our final Early Access milestone - [b]the Trivia Tricks Friend Pass![/b] Friend Pass will allow you to invite 7 friends into any online lobby through room code, [b]without them needing to purchase Trivia Tricks![/b]

Inspired by games such as It Takes Two, Friend Pass will make it much easier to bring anybody into the Trivia fun, with no Remote Play necessary! Friend Pass players will be able to partake in all gameplay options, such as Co-Op Vs Boss or even Workshop Questions!

We’ll have more information on Friend Pass (including a release date) soon, but for now consider joining the Trivia Tricks [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb][b]Discord[/b][/url] to direct any questions to us developers. We’ll be happy to answer!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/7c944471c73871e1756def635146110f646ceabd.png[/img]

Most of the last 3 months of development has been laying the groundwork to make Friend Pass possible. This has required an update to the version of Unreal Engine used and a total rework of Trivia Tricks' network code, which is no small feat! However, [b]we’ve taken this rework as an opportunity to add many user-requested features[/b] and, because almost everything has improved, we're going to breakdown these changes by feature.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/0a02e9039f07c17081b6f391820ea970e52a45dd.png[/img]

The Studio Stage was the first stage we made and after two-and-a-half years it didn't quite feel up to the standard of the others introduced since... so [b]we've given it a makeover![/b] You'll find some new stage lights and an updated player stand for Tricksters to stand on.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/97554e6833aed6b6d714d25270ad55d35ca3bce1.png[/img]

New AI characters have been added for you to quiz against! 
Please welcome [b]Mimi, Pearl, Claudia, Cap'n, Frosty, Fox, Bethany and Sarah[/b] to Trivia Tricks! 
I wonder if anyone can figure out their favorite categories?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/23e60159546405867c07d8d89ae57019ca8bba83.png[/img]

The Twitch Integrator has been reprogrammed almost entirely from scratch, giving us the opportunity to add many player-requested features...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/b99af1c0863f2361e42d7997814a022d75b197a4.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Twitch characters can now reach a majority during Chance Round Voting, [b]meaning the game will progress without having to wait for the timer to finish.[/b] This majority is calculated from the number of active participants in previous questions.
[*] The stuttering when Twitch Chat characters were added has been resolved, and, if your connection ever goes down, Twitch Chat will now attempt to reconnect to the game.
[*] And, the change you've all been waiting for, the next time you collect a key from the Twitch Connection website... WILL BE THE LAST! [b]Trivia Tricks will now refresh expired authorization tokens by itself![/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/d58d85bcd31f457c6bd97908275bc78d037588f5.png[/img]

We've been taking a look at how Trivia Tricks chooses its questions and investigating areas of improvement. While we’ve received praise on repeat questions being avoided we’ve heard your requests for more question variety during games, so...
[list]
[*] [b]Trivia Tricks will now more equally divide the selected categories.[/b] Picking two categories? The questions you'll see will be much closer to a 50/50 split than before. Picking 20 categories? Everything will be represented!
[*] Additionally, Trivia Tricks will not ask a question from the same category more than twice in a row.
[*] Finally, we've extended [b]every category with some new, relevant-for-2023 questions.[/b] Hope you've been keeping on top of things!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/264fa29af0e3fb63bd8a77be8478653bd20f1ff2.png[/img]

We are continuing to polish Workshop integration in accordance with your feedback!
[list]
[*] Only the host now needs to have question packs downloaded, meaning games will start [b]much faster.[/b]
[*] We've adjusted the metrics behind 'trending' packs, as previously selecting a pack in a lobby of 8 players would count as an 8x boost.
[*] [b]'Friend-Only' and 'Hidden' packs can now be played with anyone,[/b] but the category menu will hide the details of those packs for players who don't have the rights to see them (being marked as a "Hidden Pack" to those players).
[*] The TV will now have an icon when a Workshop question is shown.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/50ab3c560843adfaaaf9e7b99bd3052dee4dce2d.png[/img]

In preparation for Friend Pass' release we've overhauled several sections of online play, here's some of the more major adjustments...
[list]
[*] The [b]'Room Code' will be on-screen at all times in the top right corner of the screen[/b] instead of being hidden away in the pause menu. Don't worry! It still needs to be hovered to display the code.
[*] Lobby searching is much more responsive and, in the case of a failed connection, Trivia Tricks will now show a helpful message and a timeout timer. Previously this was just a black screen.
[*] We've removed the button to invite players, as this was causing confusion for Steam Remote Play and won't be compatible with Friend Pass. We recommend using Room Codes, which will work in all circumstances!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/66845e9124eef019bb01a418a1203503c7a70eee.png[/img]

It doesn't stop there, here's a few other miscellaneous improvements and bug fixes available in Version 0.9.32.24!
[list]
[*] [b]The Character Creator now has a 'randomize' button,[/b] allowing you to quickly see all sorts of whacky combinations. It will randomize to your unlocked items, meaning any generated characters are ready to be saved immediately!
[*] We've updated the icons in the Stage Selection menu to reflect the stages as they look today, as they were getting a little outdated with all the redesigns!
[*] The Chance Round joining section has had several UI elements polished, such as the thumbs next to players and the Twitch menus.
[*] The Achievements menu now works when Trivia Tricks is running without Steam. Additionally, we've fixed a bug where cosmetics tied to achievements weren't being unlocked in all circumstances.
[*] Fixed a crash that would occur if players failed to load another player's avatar.
[*] Fixed a rare softlock that had a chance to occur after failing to host a lobby.
[*] Trivia Tricks will no longer direct players between several menus with awkward transitions after failing to join a lobby.
[*] If, for whatever reason, Trivia Tricks cannot detect the monitor's information, the settings menu will now default to populating with 720/1080/1440/4k resolutions and 30/60/120/uncapped framerate options.
[*] Fixed any outstanding issues where particular textures would be displayed in low quality for a second.
[*] Fixed a bug where clients could see the Add/Remove AI buttons for a split second after joining a game.
[*] Fixed a bug where some sub-menus in the Workshop Browse Menu wouldn't close automatically after a game begins.
[*] Fixed a bug where the ‘Categories Updated!' text would stay on screen after players navigate away from the main lobby menu (such as Stage Select).
[*] Fixed a bug where a player’s inventory wouldn't immediately update upon using an item.
[*] Fixed an issue where shortcuts to Trivia Tricks would boot the game without a connection to Steam.
[*] Pre-emptively resolved a bug where Ganymede's Lab wouldn't have loaded during future seasonal events.
[*] During the development of this update Gustav picked a different color for their Bowtie. Who are we to argue?
[/list]

Wow, you really read all the way down here? We'll let you in on a little secret! 👀 [b]Open the Trivia Tricks' main menu to unlock the limited-time Lootbox and Jester Hat April Fool's cosmetics! But hurry, this giveaway ends April 6th![/b]

And finally, if you like what we’re doing, please hit the thumbs up below this news post! If you have more detailed thoughts then do consider leaving a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404090/Trivia_Tricks/][b]Steam Review[/b][/url] letting us know what you think - they really help us out! If you want to reach out to us developers then we can always be found in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb][b]Discord.[/b][/url] Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

notes.title: 🟢 🔴 Opt In or Out of Chance Round With Game Pacing Improvements! 🔴 🟢
notes.content:
Hello Tricksters and Happy New Year! We at 3-Tricks hope that you've had a comfortable holiday season doing whatever makes you happiest with plenty more of that in the year to come!

Today's update brings some changes to joining Chance Round to make it faster to get back to answering questions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/cbc95dd6b2c209ed0e0d9a39a45b410f0dc71d79.png[/img]

During the Chance Round phase you will now be prompted to join or decline at the top of the screen. Previously opting out meant waiting down the timer which could be a little awkward if nobody had the courage to risk it all. Once everyone has made their decision the timer will zip down to 0 and the Chance Round machine will immediately kick into action. Failing to make a decision will still default to not taking part - so don't fret if you can't decide in time. If you're playing with Twitch Chat then things still stay the same and they join how they have done before.

Some other changes this patch see the Workshop Categories now listed alphabetically to help with finding a certain pack to play with. You can now also use the mouse to click on your Item in your inventory to use it when playing with Keyboard and Mouse.

Like what we’re doing? Hit the thumbs up below this news post! Have more detailed thoughts? Consider leaving a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404090/Trivia_Tricks/][b]Steam Review[/b][/url] letting us know what you think. Or come chat with us devs in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb][b]Discord.[/b][/url] Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/72c0ce4dd0b54e2a02d9a237bb3f0ee3d34c5487.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added 'Yes' and 'No' buttons to the ‘Join Chance Round’ prompt. 
[*] The timer has been moved to the ‘Join Chance Round’ prompt and made larger. Before it was only present on the TV.
[*] Workshop categories are now sorted in alphabetical order in the Categories Menu.
[*] Keyboard and mouse players can now use items by clicking them in the inventory.
[*] The clock item will no longer spawn when a Twitch player is in the lobby, as it was causing there to be not enough time for the Twitch Chat to answer.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/9ec74010f65e13fd3fdb49021ca13388a14d81c7.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Mr. Tricks will now correctly refer to himself as "Count Tricks" at Halloween, and "Elf Tricks" during the Festive season in all instances.
[*] Fixed a bug where closing the Browse Workshop menu before the search finished would double the list of categories in the Categories Menu.
[*] Fixed a bug where long Question Pack names would cause the Featured Workshop Packs box to shrink on the Main Menu.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Browse Workshop and Featured Workshop Pack menus did not cap the number of characters for a Workshop title.
[*] Fixed a bug where, after being hit by the Anvil item, answers could slide under specific UI elements.
[*] Fixed a bug with the Item inventory prompt when playing with more than one type of controller.
[/list]

[b]And lastly, to everyone in the Trivia Tricks community, here’s to another year of tricky trivia![/b]

notes.title: ❄️Unlock Limited-Time Cosmetics in TRIVIA SNOWDOWN! ❄️ + New Chance Round Items!
notes.content:
Hello Tricksters! Grab a mug of hot cocoa and get under the weighted blankets, [b]it’s Trivia Snowdown time![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/dbf8aa991865263b21fc2d687fd1eda51f9af66d.png[/img]

[b]From now until January 13th Trivia Tricks will be in Snowdown mode![/b] Celebrate the season by enabling the ‘Festive’ question category, team up with your trivia pals to take on the Santa & Krampus boss, and complete limited-time Festive Missions to unlock rare cosmetics! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/c05e01ba7a6616642a5d0d92653a998f5c6e2a23.png[/img]
[b]Plus there’s 6 new collectibles in the store[/b] waiting to be unlocked by spending cookies, earned through participating in trivia!

The festive additions continue with the Chance Round item pool being expanded [b]with three new items![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/53ec4feb68385fabbea294acc6067f70ddfc4bd8.png[/img]
Firstly there’s the [b]Present,[/b] which grants 1,500 points to both yourself and another player of your choosing. Spread the festive cheer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/1a09112406daa0b42835e3de8b7fa202f5e571cc.png[/img]
There’s also the [b]Stopwatch,[/b] which halves the question timer to hurry everybody else into a panic (pairs well with the Math category). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/ef98e1295e095035587c22073b101f41980df0c4.png[/img]
Lastly, there’s [b]Call a Boss,[/b] a phone which puts you in touch with a random boss who may (or may not) know the answer to the current question.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/a2f04265dd15bc16252aa5330fff165e70ade606.png[/img]
Finally, last week we asked the kind folks in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb][b]Trivia Tricks Discord[/b][/url] what Quality of Life improvements they would like to see. Here’s some of the improvements in this update made possible thanks to your suggestions…
[list]
[*] During Chance Round voting you can now explicitly opt out of joining, meaning the timer will be skipped once all players vote
[*] Remembering lobby settings when swapping between standard and co-op mode
[*] Easier communication to hosts about category preferences
[/list]These are just some of the headliners for the many small but important improvements you’ll find in this update. Thanks to everybody for taking the time to give us these suggestions! If you’ve got any ideas about the ways we can make Trivia Tricks better then do consider leaving a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404090/Trivia_Tricks/][b]Steam Review[/b][/url] letting us know what you think.

Now, onto the full patch notes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/f0d193984f82b44184dff505d34053e98515eb47.png[/img]
[list][*] The Trivia Snowdown event is back until January 13th!
[*] The Festive category returns, how well do you know the holidays?
[*] Plus, take on Santa & Krampus in Co-Op Vs Boss Mode!
[*] 6 new festive cosmetics have been added that are available for purchase in the Character Creator using cookies, earned by participating in trivia!
[*] This is in addition to the 15 festive cosmetics from last year, which are also available again!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/ab510b67e16af15a0538ff805112cc00a206ae19.png[/img]
[list][*] The first new item, [b]the Present,[/b] will treat yourself and another player of your choosing to 1,500 points!
[*] The second new item, [b]The Stopwatch,[/b] will halve the remaining time on the question timer - use this to reduce the amount of time other players have to think!
[*] The third new item, [b]Call a Boss,[/b] will call up a random boss for a hint about the current question! Bosses will happily tell you the correct answer if they know it, but they don’t know everything so they will sometimes have to guess or only be able to narrow down the possibilities.
[*] Call a Boss will only spawn in lobbies where each player is the only one playing on their device, while the Stopwatch and Present will spawn in any lobby.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/0bcde4592b50a9f63f037d06ca1957adbb405874.png[/img]
[list][*] Players can now opt to NOT participate in the Chance Round by pressing the B button on a gamepad, or backspace on a keyboard.
[*] When all players have voted ‘Yes’ or ‘No’ to joining Chance Round, the timer will immediately end.
[*] Players can now join the Chance Round via mouse. Left clicking on the top banner will join, while right clicking it will opt to skip.
[*] The AI players will also vote no if they aren’t partaking.
[*] The longest that the AI can take to vote has been reduced from 8 seconds to 5 seconds.
[*] Some pauses have been removed or reduced during the Chance Round to speed up general game flow.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/1b4ddde8165dddf35ec72b3fa71f610b51c97ece.png[/img]
[list][*] Clients can now interact with categories in the Categories Menu, sending a message to the host that they want this category to be turned on or off!
[*] The chat is now visible in the Categories Menu when playing online.
[*] If the host swaps the game mode that is being played (such as changing from Standard to Vs Boss), their previous settings and categories are saved and will be restored if the host swaps back. This will reduce cases of players accidentally resetting their lobby settings.
[*] The "Updated!" text that appears over the Categories button now appears when the selected categories are different from when the player last viewed them.
[*] The "Settings" header button in the lobby has been renamed to "Boss" when Vs Boss Mode is active to make it clearer that the Boss can be changed in this menu.
[*] Negative’s order in the Vs Boss list has been moved to help new players experience a greater variety of bosses when the list is played in order.
[*] Players can now ready/unready faster in the lobby, and the game will start quicker when all players have readied up.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/72c0ce4dd0b54e2a02d9a237bb3f0ee3d34c5487.png[/img]
[list][*] Menu animations have generally been sped up to improve game flow.
[*] Seasonal events such as Halloween, Summer and Christmas will now load the desired Waiting Room on the Main Menu automatically. This means future seasonal events will automatically begin and end without further patches being required.
[*] The Voodoo Doll curse was a little overpowered, so we’ve nerfed it a little bit. Players now gain 25% less points when inflicted with a curse instead of 50%.
[*] Some new menu transitions have been added, such as when moving to the Character Creator from the Main Menu and back.
[*] If Twitch doesn’t answer when playing with Twitch in Vs Boss Mode, the boss will not consider the Twitch player when calculating the amount of points the boss should receive.
[*] Players now have more time to answer questions when playing against Santa & Krampus, in line with the other bosses.
[*] Addressing the feedback we received last-year, Santa & Krampus’ chance round has been sped up.
[*] Several space optimizations have been implemented, reducing the install size of Trivia Tricks.
[*] Several CPU optimizations have been implemented, improving performance when many characters are on-screen at once.
[*] Several GPU optimizations have been implemented, improving performance in the Main Menu on lower-spec machines.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/adb50d3ee1773eadbed8a8cedc81dac38916a8d2.png[/img]
[list][*] Fixed some typos and cleaned up the wording on a variety of questions. Thanks to all of you who took the time to report these to us directly!
[*] Updated several questions to be accurate following developments in the modern day.
[*] Added even more questions across all categories, many suggested by the [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord community![/url][/b] Thank you to everyone who has suggested questions so far!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/9ec74010f65e13fd3fdb49021ca13388a14d81c7.png[/img]
[list][*] Fixed a bug where AI question answering accuracy wasn't being properly reduced when items were used against them.
[*] Fixed an exploit in Vs Boss Mode where the human team could increase their score by adding new players during the final round. The Boss will now gain the same number of points that the human team does when a human player joins.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could join lobbies that did not match their current seasonal event.
[*] Fixed a memory leak when the Magnet item was used.
[*] Fixed the chat not touching the bottom of the screen.
[*] Fixed the Twitch button flying across the screen when everyone readied up in the lobby.
[*] Fixed a bug where some buttons wouldn’t always register being clicked on first try.
[*] Fixed a bug in the lobby where no sound played when hovering over AI avatars.
[/list]
Like what we’re doing? Hit the thumbs up below this news post! [b]And to everyone in the Trivia Tricks community, happy holidays![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/9ec74010f65e13fd3fdb49021ca13388a14d81c7.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The Saturday Night Trivia US timeslot has been adjusted for daylight savings.
[*] From this update onwards Trivia Tricks will auto-detect daylight savings - the Saturday Night Trivia times will adjust automatically without the need of hotfix patches.
[*] The Waiting Room on the Main Menu has been returned to normal to prepare for the end of the Halloween event later today.
[*] If a player uses a Crystal Ball, they can no longer be Dazed by the Anvil.
[*] Fixed a bug where using the Crystal Ball did not always remove the Dazed status, if the player had been Dazed [i]before[/i] using it.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Crystal Ball would not disappear from the podium if the player had another negative status while using it.
[*] Fixed a bug where players who were Dazed and then used the Crystal Ball would sometimes not receive the benefits of the Crystal Ball.
[*] Fixed a bug where clients could fill the Categories Menu with their own subscribed categories, instead of the menu being limited to the host's subscribed categories.
[*] Fixed a bug where, during the Magnet’s steal effect, the numbers on the podium would start from 0 instead of their current score.
[*] Fixed the Swap Ball playing the wrong sound effect.
[*] Potentially fixed a rare bug where the Dazed effect over Tricksters heads would last longer than intended.
[/list]

notes.title: Introducing the Latest Trivia Tricks Item 💫 THE ANVIL! 💫 + Item Polish!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/bd5c8ae73c5b011ab08456070b89cf1f9ad7fd59.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1404090/view/3382792165633956394][b]The Spook-Aversary[/b][/url] continues! You’ll find when using items Tricksters have new animations, improved particle effects and better sound effects! Not only have we improved those items introduced in the Spook-Aversary - we're introducing another item into the pool: [b]the Anvil![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/723bed536717d8d2e01dd95505428711b19ff0d6.png[/img]

Using the Anvil will instantly bonk all other contestants over their head causing them to be dazed! While Tricksters are dazed the answers will fly all over the screen making it difficult to find your answer. This effect will only last for a single question, so make sure you time it right to take full advantage of your opponents confusion!

Like what we’re doing? Hit the thumbs up below this news post! Have more detailed thoughts? Consider leaving a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404090/Trivia_Tricks/][b]Steam Review[/b][/url] letting us know what you think. Or come chat with us devs in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb][b]Discord.[/b][/url] Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

More items are already in active development, so stay tuned! The full patch notes are as follows:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/5e9015d785844eb874ebd28a7ec9f1d24501340b.png[/img]
[list][*] A new item has been added to the Chance Round, the Anvil! Use the Anvil to "Daze" your opponents and make it harder for them to answer!
[*] When you've been Dazed the answers will move across the screen, you’ll have to pay close attention to find your answer in the chaos!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/1f9c74b5e5806cecb205ce1b94eda583fcb17ad7.png[/img]
[list][*] New music has been added that will play when an item has been used that requires a Trickster to be selected (such as the "Magnet" or "Voodoo Doll")
[*] New animations have been added when the Magnet, Voodoo Doll and Crystal Ball are used.
[*] The 50/50 ball will now grey out the two incorrect answers, in addition to removing the text.
[*] A new effect has been added when points are transferred by the Magnet.
[*] Tricksters who are cursed by Voodoo will now slump and generally be sad about being cursed. :(
[*] The "Curse" effect also contains more particles, making it more obvious when Tricksters are cursed.
[*] When a negative status effect (such as curse) has expired from Tricksters will play an animation.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/9ec74010f65e13fd3fdb49021ca13388a14d81c7.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the game wouldn’t ‘time out’ if the player let the timer run out when using the Magnet or Voodoo Doll twice in the same lobby.
[*] Fixed an issue where the question's Credit would not reappear after an Item had been used.
[*] Fixed a bug where the TV was not accurately displaying earned speed bonuses when using a question timer length other than 20 seconds.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Playtime Stat in the statistics menu would lower if the player saved their game before midnight and then saved after midnight without closing the game.
[*] If a player has a negative Playtime Stat it will now be reset.
[*] Fixed a bug where the "Super Streak" and "Vision" statuses obtained in Summer's Chance Round would only last for 1 question, rather than the intended 5.
[*] Fixed an issue where the leaderboard Tab Menu did not update immediately after the Magnet had been used.
[*] Fixed a bug where the text chat box couldn't be clicked for the remainder of a question after an item had been used.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player's podium light did not turn off upon receiving an Item or Swap Ball during Chance Round.
[*] Fixed a bug where, in rare conditions, items that were not intended to spawn when local players were in the lobby could appear.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Twitch player could receive items from the Chance Round, despite not being able to use them.
[*] When a Twitch character is voting to participate in Chance Round the bar chart has been improved to update more smoothly.
