[*] All menus and menu animations in the game now properly display black borders when playing in an aspect ratio that is not 16:9.
[*] A button explaining how to add Twitch has been added to the 'How to Play' menu, found on the Character Select Screen.
[*] Trivia Tricks will now no longer lock the player's mouse to the window.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/f0d193984f82b44184dff505d34053e98515eb47.png[/img]
[list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/adb50d3ee1773eadbed8a8cedc81dac38916a8d2.png[/img]

[*] Some now-outdated questions have been updated due to developments in the modern day.

[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/9ec74010f65e13fd3fdb49021ca13388a14d81c7.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where other menus could be used while the game was paused.
[*] Fixed a bug where it was possible to access the lobby menus while changing stage on 21:9 monitors.
[*] Fixed the mouse-hiding algorithm (when only playing with controllers) not always working.
[*] Fixed the stage transition effect not covering the screen correctly on aspect ratios that aren't 16:9.
[*] Removed a leftover debug command on the Main Menu that changed the camera.
[*] Fixed a bug where the clients would have their selection changed in the lobby between the Categories and Stage buttons depending on the Lobby window currently open.

notes.title: Trivia Snowdown Holiday Event! New Stage, Boss and Challenges!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/ff6549458b86b990e5b0488f4719bcf53418e2e1.png[/img]
Happy holidays everybody! It’s me, Elf Tricks!

To celebrate the holiday season, the Trivia Snowdown event returns! With even more content to explore, including a new boss, a Festive question category, exclusive cosmetics, a whole new stage and soundtrack, this is easily our most jam-packed event yet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/757527b460449c8106a1221f66c7ecb5397c4fca.png[/img]

The cozy Winter Village is a new addition to the stage rotation, between the warm cottages and glowing fairy lights you’ll feel right at home! You’ll be answering questions in the snug village center, all eyes are on you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/50f90e8c0b72ee2f2682d10387fa0ad87f3663f8.png[/img]

Santa and Krampus return as bosses, but now they’re a tag-team?! After each round they’ll swap who’s got control of the podium, but neither is particularly happy about this uneasy alliance. The new ‘Festive’ category (featuring over 300 questions!) is the only category that is enabled by default against Santa and Krampus, but you can even the odds by adding up to 4 more categories of your choosing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/61fff01df292646c4fd14f313d72acc2a7d43595.png[/img]

You’ll also find a collection of limited-time cosmetics, with the returning cosmetics having a visual upgrade, alongside some brand new additions! These cosmetics are earned through limited-time challenges or by spending the cookies you’ll earn after every game! Good luck!

[b]Trivia Snowdown will be running from 21st December 2021 until 13th January 2022![/b] So make sure you spend your cookies and complete the challenges before then!

Like what we’re doing? Hit the thumbs up below this news post! Have more detailed thoughts? Consider leaving a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404090/Trivia_Tricks/][b]Steam Review[/b][/url] letting us know what you think, or join our ever-growing [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb][b]Discord.[/b][/url] Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

For the full patch notes, read on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/459c768f6938e4d6fce02ac1d412977243d1e28d.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Santa and Krampus return from last year! This time, they’re a single boss!
[*] After every round of questions Santa or Krampus will fight, swapping who has control of the boss podium!
[*] Depending on if Santa or Krampus is in control during the chance round you’ll get different results.
[*] Only the Festive category is enabled by default when playing against Santa and Krampus, but you can add up to 4 additional categories!
[*] Both Santa and Krampus have had a visual touch-up!
[*] Santa and Krampus are only available to play during Trivia Snowdown.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/d9929d6ba9b79cb97c1f167571219ead504a9aff.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The Festive category has been reintroduced for the Trivia Snowdown event!
[*] The Festive category contains over 300 questions based on the holiday period, including over 100 new questions added for this year's event!
[*] The Festive Category is only available during Trivia Snowdown.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/0caacf13e274f7a78151f757cb7b7720d1c367a8.png[/img]
[list]
[*] A new stage has been added to celebrate the season, the Winter Village!
[*] The Winter Village comes with its own festive soundtrack.
[*] While the Trivia Snowdown event is running Winter Village is the default stage.
[*] And when the Trivia Snowdown event is over Winter Village will remain a permanent option!
[*] Stages will now use stage-appropriate confetti when the winner is announced.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/f4c4b3e06255f064af4ba58974f14ea05962abfd.png[/img]
[list]
[*] New missions have been added, which unlock limited-time Festive cosmetics when completed!
[*] Earn cookies by playing Standard or Co-op Vs Boss games, and earn double cookies during Saturday Night Trivia!
[*] Cookies can be used to purchase limited-time festive cosmetics in the Character Creator!
[*] Over 22 limited-time cosmetics are available, with 8 being new additions for this year's event!
[*] The other 5 bosses have been given holiday-themed cosmetics!
[*] Some returning cosmetics from last year have been visually upgraded.
[*] The Trivia Snowdown cosmetics will be unavailable to purchase with cookies or through challenges after the Trivia Snowdown event is over, so earn them while you can!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/adb50d3ee1773eadbed8a8cedc81dac38916a8d2.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Alongside the 100 additional Festive questions, over 30 new questions have been added to the other categories in this update too!
[*] Many of these questions were suggested by the [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord community![/url][/b] Thank you to everyone who has suggested questions so far!
[*] Fixed some typos and cleaned up the wording on a variety of questions. Thanks to all of you who took the time to report these to us directly!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/72c0ce4dd0b54e2a02d9a237bb3f0ee3d34c5487.png[/img]
[list]
[*] You can now set an answer timer of 35 seconds - however while using Twitch it is advised to only use this setting if you are a streamer experiencing a large amount of delay (if relevant, this advice will be suggested in a dialog upon selecting the option).
[*] Trivia Tricks no longer mutes audio while minimized.
[*] Cosmetic options in the Character Creator have been placed in a more sensible order.
[*] Several cameras have been given improved panning, including new camera movements when against boss characters.
[*] The ‘Frequent Flyer’ achievement ("Play any game of Trivia on every stage") has been updated to include the Winter Village.
[*] Summer has had a slight difficulty increase to better align her with her difficulty rating.
[*] Several performance improvements, especially on systems with a CPU bottleneck.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/9ec74010f65e13fd3fdb49021ca13388a14d81c7.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the music would always restart when a question was asked.
[*] Fixed a bug where the 'Change color' button on the character creator was not always responding to mouse clicking and hovering.
[*] Fixed a bug where podium scores became unhidden if someone joined during the last round.
[*] Fixed a bug where, in a game featuring a Twitch character, clients wouldn’t see all answer options striped after they answered. This is to make group streams fair for all Twitch Chat players regardless of the stream they’re watching.
[*] Fixed an issue where searching for a lobby while experiencing connection issues would take a very long time to complete.
[*] Fixed a bug where Summer's Wave effect was always visible while answering questions on ultrawide monitors.
[*] Fixed a bug where the ‘Frequent Flyer’ achievement ("Play any game of Trivia on every stage") wasn’t being retroactively unlocked on game startup if the requirement had been met but Steam hadn’t yet granted the achievement to the players profile
[*] Fixed a misplaced camera where Mr Tricks wasn't visible when he was speaking at the start of the game and during the break between question rounds.
[*] Fixed a camera issue where the camera didn't pan to show the boss during the game intro.
[*] Improved the camera transition when a player joined midgame after a boss has finished speaking.
[*] Stopped the Guest falling into the void, endlessly
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/607d8b9baf7e8869b394ad931e0be655b400a54a.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Workshop support has been progressing during development on the Trivia Snowdown update. While this update does not add any new workshop functionality there are several under-the-hood changes in preparation for upcoming support! Be on the look-out for more updates in January and February!
[/list]

As always, thank you for following Trivia Tricks, and from us all at 3-Tricks, we wish you a Happy New Year!

notes.title: Start creating your own Workshop Question Packs today!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/05b8d5951b42c487ba7b8072eb5151d10c905967.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

Today's update marks the start of custom question packs via the Steam Workshop! This first step allows you to get ahead in creating your own category by introducing Ganymede's Lab and a way to preview how your created category will look in-game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/db6fbb7851054d8e9114124d10b711ac1a6608d5.png[/img]

Future updates to Workshop Support will let you upload these categories to Steam Workshop, share them with friends or the public and play with them online! We can't wait to see what you'll create!

As usual, you'll also find a handful of general improvements and bug fixes from the last two weeks of development! Enjoy the detailed patch notes for 0.9.9.6 below!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/607d8b9baf7e8869b394ad931e0be655b400a54a.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added Ganymede's Workshop Lab to the Main Menu! You can get there by clicking 'Workshop'!
[*] When you visit Ganymede's Workshop Lab for the first time, a 'TriviaTricks' folder is generated in your 'Documents' folder. This contains an example workshop question pack.
[*] Added a Preview option for workshop question packs, allowing you to preview your questions in-game!
[*] Created a Steam Workshop Documentation to help get you started on creating question packs. You can find it [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2662834437]here![/url][/b]
[*] Added the overall workshop main menu, with more workshop features in development and coming soon!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/fe2664cdf83f705cf53603684703ad8a1370b150.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Trivia Tricks now tracks how many games you've played on each stage.
[*] A new page has been added to the Statistics Menu which shows how many times you've played games on each stage!
[*] A new achievement has been added for playing any game of Trivia on each stage!
[*] King and Negative now have lines after their Chance Rounds have taken place!
[*] Several cameras have been changed slightly.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/adb50d3ee1773eadbed8a8cedc81dac38916a8d2.png[/img]
[list]
[*] New questions have been added!
[*] Some now-outdated questions have been updated due to developments in the modern day.
[*] Fixed some typos and cleaned up the wording on a variety of questions. Thanks to all of you who took the time to report these to us directly!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/9ec74010f65e13fd3fdb49021ca13388a14d81c7.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed the wrong camera being used after all players have answered.
[*] Fixed a bug where the stand which holds 4 of the podiums did not disappear when playing with less than 5 players for the client only.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player stand did not appear when a 5th player joined midgame.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player had to move up, down, left or right once in order to ready up if using a gamepad in the lobby.
[*] Fixed a bug where the music would sometimes restart shortly after starting to play.
[*] Fixed the 'Saving' notification being misaligned in aspect ratios other than 16:9.
[/list]

Like what we’re doing? Hit the thumbs up below this news post! Have more detailed thoughts? Consider leaving a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404090/Trivia_Tricks/][b]Steam Review[/b][/url] letting us know what you think, or join our ever-growing [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb][b]Discord.[/b][/url] Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

notes.title: Regular Update #27 - New Stage Select!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We hope that you had a fun spooky month and enjoyed our Spook-Aversary! Today, however, our Halloween-themed event must come to a close. If you didn't manage to complete all the challenges or collect all the cosmetics they'll return next year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/acd4f3388675c73aba3c0713ad9ab250997d47f0.png[/img]

While we'll no longer be all dressed up for Halloween, this update introduces Stage Selection! You'll be able to visit Halloween Hill or Isla del Trickster whenever you like (or stick to the Studio if you're more comfortable indoors)! Look forward to updates to these stages and additional locations in the future.

Finally, this build contains a handful of general improvements and bug fixes from the last couple of weeks! Enjoy the detailed patch notes for 0.9.8.4 below!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/18e1c0c90c63a0e1700a6bdc2b59726365cba84b.png[/img]
[list]
[*] You can now change stage locations right from the lobby!
[*] Return to either Halloween Hill or Isla del Trickster!
[*] Each stage has its own theme from past events!
[*] A change of pace is always nice!
[*] More locations coming soon!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/fe2664cdf83f705cf53603684703ad8a1370b150.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The Halloween Event is now over.
[*] Halloween missions and cosmetics are no longer available to unlock. You'll keep whatever cosmetics you already earned!
[*] Netcode has been optimized with improved performance.
[*] Ready timer now displays '0:00' instead of 'Game starting...' when the timer reaches 0.
[*] Saturday Night Trivia times have been updated to reflect US Daylight Savings changes.
[*] Improved crash logging and collection. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/adb50d3ee1773eadbed8a8cedc81dac38916a8d2.png[/img]
[list]
[*] New questions have been added!
[*] The Halloween questions have been migrated to suitable categories where appropriate.
[*] Some now-outdated questions have been updated due to developments in the modern day.
[*] Fixed some typos and cleaned up the wording on a variety of questions. Thanks to all of you who took the time to report these to us directly!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/9ec74010f65e13fd3fdb49021ca13388a14d81c7.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the lights would change during the ending if someone joined midgame.
[*] Fixed a bug where the boss podium may display the wrong boss name on slower connections.
[*] Fixed a rare crash where the host closed a lobby with at least one other player connected.
[/list]

Like what we’re doing? Hit the thumbs up below this news post! Have more detailed thoughts? Consider leaving a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404090/Trivia_Tricks/][b]Steam Review[/b][/url] letting us know what you think, or join our ever-growing [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb][b]Discord.[/b][/url] Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

notes.title: Trivia Tricks 0.9.7.6 (EU Saturday Night Trivia Daylight Savings)
notes.content:
Howdy! Hope y'all are enjoying [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1404090/view/3042737430881485319][b]the Spook-Aversary[/b][/url] so far! [b]This is a small hotfix internally moving the EU Saturday Night Trivia start time to coincide with the ending of Daylight Saving Time.[/b] As daylight savings is still observed in the US for an extra week no changes have been made to the US Saturday Night Trivia start time.

[list]
[*] The internal EU Saturday Night Trivia time slot has been adjusted for the ending of summer time. As a reminder, the EU Saturday Night Trivia time slot is...
[list]

[*] 7pm - 8pm UTC (Sat)
[*] 7pm - 8pm GMT (Sat)
[*] 3pm - 4pm EST (Sat)
[*] 2pm - 3pm CST (Sat)
[*] 12pm - 1pm PST (Sat)
[/list]
[*] The US Saturday Night Trivia time is unaffected in this update and will be changed next week.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Rainbow Shirt was using the Mummy Shirt texture.
[/list]

Please let us know what you think on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1404090/discussions/]Steam Discussion Forum[/url] or join our ever-growing [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord.[/url] Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

notes.title: Happy Spook-Aversary! Celebrating 1 year of updates with a BOO!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/35d2af5e588ceec2d3001a3f78ed7830fa030eac.png[/img]

Hey everyone, Count Tricks here! 

It's that time of year when everything turns a little spooky - and what’s scarier than the passage of time?! To celebrate both Halloween and a whole year of Trivia Tricks updates we're ditching the studio in favor of a much more fitting atmosphere! This new Halloween event will be running [b]from October 27th to Novemeber 11th![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/2ab333694ce1e23efb108b15ea723dca7e4ac56f.png[/img]

We'll be running our little quiz on the grounds of 'Halloween Hill' - hopefully you'll have the courage to join us! There’s also a limited time 'Halloween' question category, testing your knowledge on anything scary!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/29fdc10961b9381314667065d6f0d35a1d0ed349.png[/img]

Some event missions have also been added with limited time Halloween Cosmetics as rewards! Finishing games will also reward you with Candy which can be used to purchase other Halloween items in the Character Creator - including last year's event cosmetics being available again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/604e10eb2f1c4300b9bc5b0b08e44273b0fc9506.png[/img]

While we all love Halloween, let’s not forget today marks 1 year since the release of Trivia Tricks! This year has flown by with a Regular Update releasing on average every 2 weeks. That's a lot of updates! We’ve put together a recap on the past year further below.

Let's mark the occasion with some cake! Wait, why are you putting it on your head? Well, ok!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/16b45fd9eb957dcc3493bb4d3f30d7739ce6338f.png[/img]

[list]
[*] We've headed on over to Halloween Hill! Enjoy the spooky manor grounds!
[*] Plus we’ve put together some Halloween music to go with it!
[*] 6 limited time challenges with Halloween themed rewards!
[*] Earn Candy by finishing a game in any mode, play well for more candy!
[*] Swap your Candy for purchasable cosmetics in the Character Creator!
[*] Wearable Birthday Cake for everyone!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/7acd4aa1b2208bb5715f08ae748116edf454dabb.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Permanently increased the category veto count, allowing you to narrow down category selection even more!
[*] The Pumpkin hat now glows! Ominous!
[*] Accessories and shirts can now have animations, check out the new Demon Wings and Devil Tail for examples!
[*] Further development progress on Steam Workshop Support for custom question packs
[*] Fixed a bug where the counter for number of times a question has been seen (Which is used to give lobbies unique questions) would reset if a question was moved to a different category
[*] Fixed a bug where the counter for number of times a question has been seen (Which is used to give lobbies unique questions) would reset if a question was removed from the pool of available questions but later re-added
[*] Fixed a bug in the Character Creator where changing the color of a cosmetic while wearing conflicting accessories would make both accessories be visible on a character
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/ab0a299757b7533eb3031c1fff6f8203efa047a1.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Added 80 additional questions, many suggested by the [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord community![/url][/b] Thank you to everyone who has suggested questions so far!
[*] The Halloween category has been reintroduced! Tons a of Halloween appropriate questions from our existing categories and some Halloween-specific trivia!
[*] Trivia Tricks now features over 5,000 questions!
[*] Any question which has an answer option of Green/Red/Blue/Yellow will now place that answer option on the respective color, which should make communication against Summer a lot easier!
[*] Any question which has an answer option of 1/2/3/4 will now place that option on the respective field for Twitch ordering.
[*] Questions with numbered answers will display their answers in sequential order, unless it would break the above rule or is in the Mathematics category.
[*] Fixed some typos and cleaned up the wording on a variety of questions. Thanks to all of you who took the time to report these to us directly!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/2d42766754adc0a7885e27da1da2ca6c3ffcbd5d.png[/img]

[list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/s3per2c.png[/img]
[list]

[*] Six permanent bosses, each with unique challenges.
[*] Bosses have their own animations and dialogue.
[*] Communication improvements showing team members' selected answers.
[*] A stage redesign to give bosses a larger focus.
[*] New TV leaderboard breaking down individual team member scores.
[*] Boss AI rework for more consistent performance, alongside smarter Co-Op AI pals.
[/list][/list]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/9959b2c59215561e361cc845fbee44cd5d360522.png[/img]
[list]

[*] Add your Twitch Chat to your game in either competitive or cooperative play.
[*] With an extension to allow adding up to four Twitch Chats into the same game.
[*] See the smartest members of your chat in the final leaderboards.
[*] And have your Twitch details saved for future use.
[/list][/list]
[list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ae3wZwc.png[/img]
[list]

[*] Customizable category selection.
[*] Character Creation accessories for cosmetics like glasses.
[*] Ability to join any game in progress, even if there’s no AI player to take over.
[*] Questions that have been seen before are filtered out of future games to ensure minimal repeats.
[*] Options to allow players to adjust answering time, chance round odds, and changeable & visible answer selections.
[*] Weekly community events with Saturday Night Trivia.
[*] Secret codes and community ARG hunts.
[*] Updating Trivia Tricks to a DRM-free standard.
[/list][/list]
[list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/iFZ80T2.png[/img]
[list]

[*] Steam Remote Play support, enabling phones as controllers.
[*] Streamlined Controller Connect and Character Select Menu.
[*] Redesigned the Host Menu to support new customisation options.
[*] Added a Tab Menu to keep track of the leaderboard mid-game.
[*] Room codes, enabling inviting people without needing them to be on your Steam Friends List.
[*] ‘Smart prompts’,  displaying up specifically when players need usability guidance
[*] An official Remote Play Guide
[/list][/list]
[list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ulhaSaX.png[/img]
[list]

[*] Over 1,500 brand new hand-written questions added, including suggestions from our community.
[*] 91 new wearable cosmetics.
[*] 10 additional achievements.
[*] 3 new AI characters, created from a community contest.
[*] 4 seasonal events.
[/list][/list]

Like what we’re doing? Hit the thumbs up below this news post! Have more detailed thoughts? Consider leaving a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404090/Trivia_Tricks/][b]Steam Review[/b][/url] letting us know what you think, or join our ever-growing [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb][b]Discord.[/b][/url] Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

notes.title: Regular Update #25 - Bugs Squashed and Engine Updated!
notes.content:
Hello Tricksters!

This release may seem small in content but it’s huge in potential! We’ve upgraded the engine that Trivia Tricks is built on, laying the groundwork for making several upcoming features possible!

As this update is an interim step to other exciting things we’re not making a big show about it in your news feeds. But, as you were nice enough to still check out these patch notes anyway, we’ll let you in on a little secret!... [b]Development on our yearly Halloween event is underway![/b] 🎃 Get involved by suggesting Halloween-related trivia questions to build up the Halloween category in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb][b]Discord![/b][/url]

Finally, this build contains a handful of general improvements and bug fixes from the last couple of weeks! Enjoy the detailed patch notes for 0.9.6.5 below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/72c0ce4dd0b54e2a02d9a237bb3f0ee3d34c5487.png[/img]
[list]
[*] When Change Answers is enabled, each players buzzer sound will be capped at playing twice per question to prevent spamming.
[*] Podiums now display streaks and speed bonuses after the camera has zoomed out from the TV to ensure the effects are visible.
[*] The Twitch Answer Bar Charts during answer reveals are now in order from left-to-right in the order that they were added to the game.
[*] The Twitch Answer Bar Charts now animate off screen.
[*] Fixed some typos and cleaned up the wording on a variety of questions. Thanks to all of you who took the time to report these to us directly!
[*] Smoothed the transition between cameras during gameplay
[*] Upgraded our version of Unreal Engine and our used plugins.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/9ec74010f65e13fd3fdb49021ca13388a14d81c7.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where, when players joined a game in progress without taking over an AI slot, they would have zero points instead of being given the expected catchup amount.
[*] Fixed a bug where, when players joined a game in progress without taking over an AI slot, the streak flame effect could be placed on the wrong podium.
[*] Fixed a rare bug where, when players joined a game in progress without taking over an AI slot, the new players would not be placed on their podium.
[*] Questions that are marked to enforce their answering order will now do so the Twitch order instead of starting from the bottom answer and rotating clockwise
[*] Improved connection reliability to Twitch
[*] Set a character limit to the Twitch Authorisation Code text box
[*] Fixed rare cases where the wrong camera could be used
[/list]

Like what we’re doing? Hit the thumbs up below this news post! Have more detailed thoughts? Let us know what you think on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1404090/discussions/][b]Steam Discussion Forum[/b][/url] or join our ever-growing [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb][b]Discord.[/b][/url] Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

notes.title: Compete With Up To 4 Twitch Chats In The Same Game!
notes.content:
Hello Tricksters!

This update completes our Twitch Integration Early Access milestone with our most requested feature - [b]connecting multiple Twitch Chats into the same game![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/1b1744ea043024692e01525a3bb44e08418d2e36.png[/img]

Running a collab stream? Now you can pit your chats against each other and see who has the smartest viewers!

We also took this time to address the feedback we’ve received from streamers and redesigned the Twitch connection flow. Your account details and chat nickname will now be saved, allowing you to add any previously used Twitch Chats with a single button. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/66a4b2570dd623dbeb77cf4a792b170c56dd8c0b.png[/img]

Twitch characters now also wear hats to help them stand out in a crowd of purple! This update marks the completion of our Twitch Integration Early Access milestone, however, this doesn’t mean we’re finished with Twitch Integration! Just like Co-Op Vs Boss mode we will continue to expand our integration with improvements and maintainance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/dca5993a788efaa71e627319c00b8a58a8138403.png[/img]

There's some new community suggested cosmetics included in this update, as well as a new model for the Hoodie. Want your killer cosmetic idea added to Trivia Tricks? Send what you’re thinking in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb][b]Discord[/b][/url] and we’ll see what we can do!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/f2a6d444d872d320b864384460601ea996b3687d.png[/img]

Last of our major features is a new ‘How To Play’ menu, which will open on your first visit to the Character Select Screen. This continues our efforts started our previous release, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1404090/view/2965044616810727831][b]Regular Update #23,[/b][/url] to give better tutorials to new players. Already know how you want to play? Just tick ‘Don’t Show Again’ and the menu will stop automatically opening.

Got all that? Those are just a selection of the changes that are now available in version 0.9.5.5! Interested in the full changes? Read on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/d3b5f2dba5ff23cfa66099a8619b82f95417a15f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Up to four Twitch Chats can be added to a single game! Pit your audiences against each other and see whose Twitch Chat is the smartest!
[*] The interface for adding Twitch Integration to your lobby has been redesigned with a focus on streamlining the experience, especially in the case of errors
[*] Entered Account and Chat Names will be remembered for future use
[*] The Twitch character will wear cosmetics when added to the game, giving each a unique identity
[*] The scroll speed of the 5Heads popup showing which viewers got the answer correct will now scroll slower for smaller streams and faster for larger
[*] Each of the four Twitch Chats gets their own bar-chart breakdown of Twitch Answers, while the 5Heads and overall viewer winner menus will mix the chats together
[*] All players will now see the Twitch A/B/C/D or 1/2/3/4 next to the answers when a Twitch character is in the game
[*] The Twitch-specific commands (Such as !dance) have been made inactive to resolve a potential game crash
[*] A number of security improvements for Twitch Integration functions have been implemented
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/72c0ce4dd0b54e2a02d9a237bb3f0ee3d34c5487.png[/img]
[list]
[*] On your session’s first visit to the Character Select Screen a new ‘How To Play’ menu will be shown, with explanations on how to play with friends. Learn how to play when: ‘My friends own Trivia Tricks’, ‘My friends are next to me’ or ‘My friends don’t own Trivia Tricks’!
[*] These have also been added to our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2551430764][b]Official Remote Play Guide![/b][/url]
[*] If you tick ‘Don’t Show Again’ for this menu then it will stop automatically displaying unless you explicitly press the button to bring it up!
[*] When the answer to a question is being revealed the answer camera will now zoom into the TV, making the text more readable for players who are far away from their displays (such as playing Trivia Tricks from a couch in a group, or on Remote Play to a phone)
[*] You’ll find two new cosmetics for your head in the Character Creator! The ‘Spiky Quiff’ and the ‘Chefs Hat’!
[*] The ‘Hoodie’ shirt has been given a new model
[*] The ‘Updated!’ text for the categories button now periodically bounces until the categories menu is opened, instead of bouncing once when categories are updated
[*] White borders have now been added to the highlighted state of every button, making it clearer for controller players which button is currently highlighted 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/adb50d3ee1773eadbed8a8cedc81dac38916a8d2.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added 40 additional questions, the vast majority suggested by the [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord community![/url][/b] Thank you to everyone who has suggested questions so far!
[*] Fixed some typos and cleaned up the wording on a variety of questions. Thanks to all of you who took the time to report these to us directly!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/9ec74010f65e13fd3fdb49021ca13388a14d81c7.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where, during the start of a game, the TV wouldn’t be entirely in frame when the bonuses were shown
[*] Fixed a bug where Mr. Tricks would try to talk about so many players at once that he would talk himself off-screen (he’s always been a chatterbox...)
[*] Mr. Tricks will now talk for longer when new players join (see, chatterbox!) to fix a 
disconnect issue when many players with bad connections join at once
[*] Fixed a bug where the spotlight on the title screen was off
[*] Fixed a bug where the stage lights would display the wrong pattern if a player joined during the ending leaderboard reveal
[*] Fixed a bug where the camera would suddenly snap to the TV when displaying the answers if a player didn't answer
[*] Fixed a bug where, if players entered an input from an unconnected gamepad, the displayed message's prompt did not correctly cycle through all the inputs possible
[/list]

Like what we’re doing? Hit the thumbs up below this news post! Have more detailed thoughts? Let us know what you think on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1404090/discussions/][b]Steam Discussion Forum[/b][/url] or join our ever-growing [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb][b]Discord.[/b][/url] Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

notes.title: New Characters + Improvements to Online Play and Twitch!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

This update brings a host of quality of life improvements and addresses user feedback that we've received in our various channels! There's so much going on we're going to highlight some of the biggest changes! Read on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/77e05a1835f2e62432fcef4fc052822566daf6e3.png[/img]

Every day we see more streamers involving their audience through games of Trivia Tricks. We've been compiling the main points of feedback from these streams and this update is aimed at addressing them. Here are some of the headlining changes, but there's even more in the detailed list below!
[list]
[*] The top 3 Twitch users who answered correctly in your chat will now be displayed at the end of a game! Who's the smartest member in your community?
[*] Twitch users who answered a question correctly are now shown in a '5Heads' section at the bottom right corner of the screen
[*] You can now select a question timer of 30 seconds. Try choosing this if you have a long stream delay with Twitch! Additionally, when playing with Twitch Chat, the question timer for bosses is automatically increased from 20 seconds to 25 seconds.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/d4d5a743e81df210f9d3c84916a86da61a3220c2.png[/img]

We're always thinking of ways to make Trivia Tricks more user friendly, and we thought this was the time to address some of that feedback! Some of our bigger changes in this update are...

[list]
[*] You can now join any in-progress online game without needing to take over an AI!
[*] AI players in 'Co-Op Vs Boss Mode' will now be better teammates by being more willing to trust their human friends and follow their answer if they are unsure.
[*] Added a number of 'smart prompts' that will guide players we detect making common first-time user errors.
[*] A number of visual tweaks that will make certain game events clearer. For example the 'Updated' text above categories now bounces and the 'Join chance round' text now flashes.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/60373b1697e94e8c21359b7c9b90eb1478acaa4d.png[/img]

Our AI Character Contest came to a close recently and winners have been chosen! Meet 'Zoopy', 'Giovanni' and 'Gustav', with congratulations to the Discord winners: [b]'The First Note of Mambo No. 5', 'Noctua Spell', and 'Toasty'[/b] respectively!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/88df648eca4595226e476dbeb4eec0e5cbcb24f2.png[/img]

This update also brings three additional cosmetics to the character creator that were direct suggestions by our community! The 'Bread' accessory, 'Spilt Noodles' hat and the 'I Love Trivia' shirt! Want your ideas in Trivia Tricks? [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Join our Discord[/url][/b] and let us know what you think!

Lastly, Summer is coming to a close and as such our Summer Splash event has now finished! Thanks to everyone who took part and we hope you enjoyed our little island getaway. While the missions are leaving, Summer herself will be remaining as a permanent boss character, alongside any cosmetics you've earned. We've appreciated the warm response to the change of stage location and hope to find a way to have Isle de Trickster return in the future... 

Phew! Those are just some of the changes that are coming alongside version 0.9.4.2! Interested in the full changes? Read on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/72c0ce4dd0b54e2a02d9a237bb3f0ee3d34c5487.png[/img]
[list]
[*] You can now join online games that are in progress that have no AI slots! Previously you could only join an online game that had started if there was an AI player to take over, but now you can join games regardless!
[*] You can now select a question timer of 30 seconds.
[*] 3 new community suggested items have been added to the Character Creator! The 'Bread' accessory, the 'Spilt Noodles' hat and the 'I Love Trivia' shirt!
[*] The winners of the AI competition have been added into the random pool! Meet 'Giovanni', 'Zoopy' and 'Gustav'!
[*] The AI now have a chance to follow the human player answers in 'Co-Op Vs Boss Mode'. They may also change answers to the human answers if they had already answered but were unsure.
[*] If you've been struggling to beat Summer in an Offline 'Co-Op Vs Boss' game for the achievement, try again with these changes!
[*] 'Game is full' dialog boxes have been updated to remove the mention of AI
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/d3b5f2dba5ff23cfa66099a8619b82f95417a15f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The top 3 Twitch users who answered correctly in your chat for that game will now be displayed at the end of a game.
[*] Twitch users who answered a question correctly are now shown in the bottom right corner of the screen rather than flying across the screen at the end of a question. This is much more readable and hopefully solves some bitrate issues!
[*] You can now select a question timer of 30 seconds. Try choosing this if you have longer stream delays with Twitch!
[*] Going against a boss with your Twitch Chat? The timer will automatically set itself to 25 seconds instead of 20!
[*] When playing as a Twitch user, trying to answer with '1/2/3/4' while 'A/B/C/D' is visible will no longer count as an answer and vice versa. This is to aid streamers with longer stream delays, as their viewers would sometimes answer the next question by mistake.
[*] The Twitch answer breakdown chart will now show '1/2/3/4' if the Twitch users had to answer using '1/2/3/4', rather than always showing 'A/B/C/D'.
[*] After answering 2 questions with the mouse the game will inform the streamer they can answer discreetly with the 'WASD' keys.
[*] Some connection error messages have been updated to be clearer of cause.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/adb50d3ee1773eadbed8a8cedc81dac38916a8d2.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added over 30 additional questions, the vast majority suggested by the [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord community![/url][/b] Thank you to everyone who has suggested questions so far!
[*] Some now-outdated questions have been updated due to developments in the modern day.
[*] Fixed some typos and cleaned up the wording on a variety of questions. Thanks to all of you who took the time to report these to us directly!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/e44d08842358857b11effc6d78437ef69d8bd8f3.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added a prompt to help players who may be trying to add players in the wrong places.
[*] Added a prompt to remind players they can answer discreetly with 'WASD' keys if they are playing with any local, remote or Twitch players.
[*] The 'Updated!' text above the categories button now animates when the categories have been changed to make it clearer when they have been changed.
[*] The 'Press A/Space to Join Chance Round!' message now blinks to stand out more to new players.
[*] You can now vote to skip dialogue by mouse, just click the bottom right skip button!
[*] The message users see when they try to play online but do not have Steam running has been updated to suggest users check their Firewall/Anti-Virus if Steam is currently running on their computer.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/fe2664cdf83f705cf53603684703ad8a1370b150.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The lobby camera is now the same regardless of if the lobby is currently in 'Standard' or 'Co-op Vs Boss' mode.
[*] The Chance Ball Machine is now visible in the lobby if playing a 'Standard Game' regardless of whether Chance Round has been enabled.
[*] At least one Easter Egg! Sneaky!
[*] The Summer Splash event has now ended.
[*] Summer Splash cosmetics are no longer purchasable in the character creator, but you will keep any purchased cosmetics!
[*] Summer Splash missions are no longer shown on the main menu, but you will keep any earned cosmetics!
[*] Summer remains as a permanent boss character.
[*] The stage is back to normal, but Isle de Trickster will hopefully return soon!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/9ec74010f65e13fd3fdb49021ca13388a14d81c7.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where full lobbies were not shown in the server browser.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Room Code search wouldn't find new lobbies that had been created since the last 'lobby search' was ran
[*] Fixed a rare crash that could happen when leaving lobbies.
[*] Fixed a bug where closed lobbies would sometimes still appear in the server browser until the host fully closed Trivia Tricks
[*] Fixed a bug where bosses' cry emote particle appeared incorrectly.
[*] Added various fixes to Podium name plates sometimes disappearing mid-game or not being visible.
[*] Fixed a bug where, after playing a 'Co-Op Vs Boss Mode' game, the 'games played' achievements would not unlock until a 'Standard Game' was played or Trivia Tricks was restarted.
[*] Fixed 'Unlucky Kitty' unlocking when the winner was announced, instead of when the loser is first shown.
[*] Fixed a bug where, if both a keyboard and controller player were on the same device, the 'Press A/Space to Join Chance Round' message wouldn't alternate its shown input.
[*] Fixed a bug where, if you couldn't join a game on the server browser due to it being full, it would inform you that the 'game had already started'. This has been fixed to inform you that the game is full.
[*] Fixed cases of text in dialog boxes overflowing.
[*] Fixed a bug where the podium did not turn its light off if you got the 1.5x ball in Chance Round while on negative points.
[*] The 'Joining soon' message has been adjusted to better suit higher resolutions.
[/list]

Please let us know what you think on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1404090/discussions/][b]Steam Discussion Forum[/b][/url] or join our ever-growing [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb][b]Discord.[/b][/url] Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

notes.title: Summer Splash Event! New Stage, Boss and Challenges!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QZtf6em.gif[/img]

Welcome, Tricksters, to your holiday getaway!

The Trivia Tricks Summer Splash event is now available! Complete limited-time challenges to unlock exclusive Summer Splash cosmetics and, after warming up, test your team's communication skills against our hardest boss yet, Summer! All hosted by Mr Tricks on Isle de Trickster!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UWQUHV1.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4E2YRNd.png[/img]

Introducing our latest boss, Summer! She's one with the waves and she's not afraid to use them! When facing off against Summer she will hide a different selection of answers for each player, so you'll need to communicate as a team to narrow down the right answer! Furthermore, Summer's Chance Round is a little different... introducing status effects!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6ULf9kO.png[/img]

Summer can ink Tricksters and take away some visibility of the current question, or freeze Tricksters in a block of ice! It's not all bad news though, the magnifying glass will help you see past Summer's shells, and the brand new super streak will also grant an incredible 2,500 points for every correct answer!... if you can keep it! In a future update we'll introduce these chance round effects to Standard Trivia, so stay tuned!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TpK1p3o.png[/img]

Finally, Summer Splash includes some limited-time challenges! Some will reward you with Summer Shells that can be exchanged for cosmetics, while others will give exclusive items immediately on completion! The fun's only just beginning as more challenges and cosmetics will launch on the 14th August!

Got all that? Ok! Below you'll find the detailed patch notes to 0.9.2.4 Summer Splash!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/09yQh9N.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Leave the studio behind and enjoy Isle de Trickster!
[*] Five new challenges which reward limited-time currency, Summer Shells and cosmetics when completed!
[*] More challenges and cosmetics will launch on August 14th!
[*] Negative and King have dressed for the occasion too! Check them out!
[*] Meet Summer, our first four star difficulty boss! Read her unique play mechanics below!
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LzpjtWB.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Summer will hide a different selection of answers for each player, so you'll need to communicate as a team to narrow down the right answer!
[*] Playing solo or only with local players? Summer becomes a memory challenge as the visible answer will alternate with time! Keep your head sharp!

[*] If you get hit by octopus ink while playing with other players you won't be able to read the question at all! Ask your friends for direction!
[*] Playing solo or with local players? Only some of the question will be covered proportional to the number of players inked. Try to fill in the gaps as a team!

[b]Magnifying Glass[/b]

[*] The magnifying glass will let you see through Summer's shells and make more answers visible at once!

notes.title: Stage Renovation, Over 100 New Questions + Twitch Polish!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's only been two weeks since the Twitch Integration beta launched but already we have been humbled by its popularity! We've been closely observing (and joining!) Twitch streams to collect feedback on the future direction to take the beta, therefore we've focused the changes in this patch to addressing the connection and usability issues we had noticed. Hopefully these changes in this update will make 
Twitch Integration a more reliable!

However, it's not all about streamers! We've put some extra design touches on to the stage! Now the Chance Round machine and Trivia Bosses have their own platform and set of lights. We'd say this is a [i]step up[/i] from their previous location!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/89qHqnE.png[/img]

Lastly, you'll find over 100 new questions in this update, bringing our total to over 4,800! We would like to thank everybody who has submitted questions through our Discord for making such a dizzying possible. Speaking of Discord, our [b]AI Character Contest[/b], where you can get your own character designs added to the game, is ongoing for just another two weeks! All you need to do is [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]join Discord[/url][/b], drop a picture and you might be lucky enough to see them added as a permanent contestant in a future update! Get them in by [b]July 21st[/b]!

Check out the full patch notes below! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nnKbNYv.png[/img]
[list]
[*] If the Twitch character is in the game the Speed bonus will be turned off regardless of the player's settings for balance purposes as the Twitch character is unable to achieve Speed bonuses. 
[*] If nobody in Twitch chat answers, the Twitch character will not answer the current question. If this happened previously the Twitch character would select a random answer but they would not gain points.
[*] Added a suggestion to the Twitch info menu for streamers to use W/A/S/D or arrow keys instead of the mouse to stop them revealing their answers to chat!
[*] Pressing backspace will no longer leave the Twitch menus, as this was causing players to close the menu while typing their usernames!
[*] Fixed a bug where the Twitch character had an AI avatar on the TV for the final leaderboard, when they should have had the Twitch avatar.
[*] Twitch Answers sent after the Twitch Character has selected an answer are no longer counted in the bar chart showing the % of answers.
[*] The initial connection attempt to Twitch and the subsequent connection to Twitch Chat will now automatically retry if they fail on their first attempt. This should make the connection flow significantly more reliable and consistent.
[*] If the Twitch character loses connection during a game it will attempt to reconnect at the start of each new question.
[*] If the Twitch character loses connection in the pre-game lobby, or after a game ended, they will now be kicked from the game, but can be re-added through the regular 'Add Twitch Chat' method. Previously this led to a Twitch character that would ignore Twitch Chat until the lobby was closed and reopened.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kCJeqoN.png[/img]
[list]
[*] A new area of the stage has been added. The Chance Round machine and Trivia Bosses now sit on their own platform!
[*] This new area comes with its own set of lights.
[*] The Chance Round's ball machine is now visible in standard games even when the Chance Round hasn't been enabled.
[*] A few cameras have been changed to better frame these stage changes.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TD69FLY.png[/img]
[list]

notes.title: Twitch Integration Live! + Accessories For Characters!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're proud to introduce our latest update featuring a beta of our Twitch Integration milestone, a significantly expanded character customization feature and an event to get your Trickster on the world stage!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/aJC40T4.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7leGbVs.png[/img]

This update brings Twitch Integration support to Trivia Tricks, allowing Twitch Chat to participate as a contestant on the show! Team up with your viewers to take down Trivia Bosses together or take your viewers on in a battle of Trivia brainpower! (Chat can't be that smart... right?)

Beyond just answering questions, viewers who picked the right answer will have their names fly across the screen. The Twitch character can react with emotes' through a few commands too such as: !laugh, !cry, !angry, !shock, and !dance. Streamers have an option to limit chat participation to subscribers only, and Bits will be thrown onstage proportional to the tier that has been cheered. We're extremely proud of our Twitch Integration feature level, but we have chosen to label it as a beta to make clear we're still looking to extend it with your input! We'll be watching streams, engaging with your feedback on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb][b]Discord[/b][/url] and continuing to expand Twitch Integration over the coming weeks! Let us know what you think!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8kUx9HN.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wVJK34Z.png[/img]

One of Trivia Tricks' most celebrated features is its character customization, however we've heard many glasses-wearing players didn't appreciate having to go bald if they want to bring specs on stage!

We're happy to unveil that today's update adds two 'accessory' slots in the character creator! This will unbuckle glasses, ties, scarfs, floating moons [i](wait what?)[/i] and a selection of other cosmetics from the original four slots. We've also taken this time to update the physics and visuals on some of our existing fan-favorite items and add a few new surprises while we're at it. Please check out the new options available in the character creator and send us your favorites!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Eew6wla.png[/img]

The Trivia Tricks Discord continues to pop off! To start with, the show is looking for more contestants! With the expanded character creator now seems the perfect time to expand our AI roster and we're turning to the community for inspiration! In our [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb][b]Discord[/b][/url] you'll find a new channel dedicated to sharing pictures of your favorite created characters. The best of the best will be added to Trivia Tricks pool of potential AI! This event will come to an end at a future date so get them in ASAP!

Finally, we love seeing your diverse question suggestions and integrating them into each update, but we understandably had feedback from players wishing they could suggest questions without posting them in a public channel. This is now no longer the case! You will find Question Bot in our Discord, who will be happy to collect your question submissions in DMs and automatically send them to us for consideration in future updates. Give it a shot!

Wow! That was a lot. If you're looking for complete patch notes and bug fixes in bullet point format, well, read on! Here's the full patch notes for Trivia Tricks version 0.9.0.2!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tTj71Op.png[/img]

[h3]Twitch Beta![/h3]
[list]
[*] The Twitch Beta is here! Add your Twitch audience as a playable character who you can play against in Standard Trivia, or work together in Vs Boss Mode!
[*] The Twitch button in the bottom right of the Lobby will walk you through the process. You will need to go to the Trivia Tricks website, then log into Twitch and receive a token. Once this token has been pasted in, enter your Twitch account name, give your chat a nickname and you're good to go!
[*] Once the Twitch character has been added, your chat will be able to answer questions by sending A/B/C/D or 1/2/3/4 in Twitch Chat.
[*] Whenever Twitch Chat is in play your answer options will have A/B/C/D or 1/2/3/4 next to them so that your Twitch Chat will know how to answer.
[*] The Twitch character will choose whichever answer has the highest number of votes from the Twitch Chat when there is 1 second remaining on the answer timer. If no one answers, they will choose a random answer.
[*] The Twitch character will receive points in proportion to the audience that got the answer correct, for example, if 80% of the chat was correct then the Twitch character will receive 80% of the points for choosing the correct answer.
[*] If the Twitch character answers correctly, the names of 20 random Twitch users who got the answer correct will be shown on-screen!
[*] If you receive any Bits, the Twitch character will throw Bits on stage in proportion to donation amount!
[*] The Twitch Chat can use commands to make the Twitch character play various animations, such as dancing and crying!
[*] Please note that the Twitch character counts as a player - so if you want to play with the Twitch character you will need to set aside a slot for them to join!
[/list]

[h3]New Accessory Slots For Additional Character Customization![/h3]
[list]
[*] The number of cosmetics that your character can wear has been increased from 4 to 6!
[*] It is now possible to wear a variety of cosmetic combinations that weren't possible previously, like wearing both hats and glasses, or scarfs and shirts!
[*] These cosmetics have been moved to the 'Accessory' category instead of the 'Hats' or 'Shirts' category.
[*] The tabs at the top of the Character Creator have updated designs to support the extra options!
[*] However there are a few cases where some cosmetics can't be worn together (such as the 'Count's Cape' and the 'Guitar').
[*] Your saved characters will automatically update to move any relevant cosmetics to the correct slots.
[*] We've added some new cosmetics! 'Rainbow Shirt', 'Propeller Hat' and 'Disguise Glasses'. Good news, 'Rainbow Shirt' is free to all!
[*] The 'Up Arrow' and 'Down Arrow' shirts have been updated to 'Gains' and 'Losses' and have been given a more animated look! If you were lucky (or unlucky) enough to have had these shirts unlocked before then you will find them automatically unlocked!
[*] The 'Scarf', 'Bowtie' and 'Tie' have been re-modeled to suit being worn with shirts.
[*] The physics on the 'Count's Cape' item has been fixed! It now flows much more naturally!
[*] Let us know what characters you've now been able to make on our Discord and you may just be facing them as AI in future updates!
[/list]

[h3]Usability Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] The area around the 'Ready Up!' button in the lobby screen has been redesigned, most notably the 'Categories' button has been moved to that corner.
[*] If the categories are changed (for example, when switching between bosses) a small "Updated!" alert will appear above the categories button - this should help make it clear when categories have been adjusted without needing to open the window!
[*] Chat messages have been updated so the player's name appears bolder than their message.
[/list]

[h3]Question Database Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] New questions have been added - including suggestions from our Discord community!
[*] The quality of questions in various categories have been improved, such as the Music and Animals category.
[*] Fixed various typos.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where a player who joined midgame during the Chance Round would be able to hear the Chance Round balls spawning while waiting to join.
[*] The up/down arrows indicating player's rankings have been hidden during the screen asking for the player's Chance Round participation, they were not intended to be shown here and as such were not reflecting actual ranking adjustments!
[/list]

Please let us know what you think on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1404090/discussions/][b]Steam Discussion Forum[/b][/url] or join our ever-growing [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb][b]Discord.[/b][/url] Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

notes.title: Saturday Night Trivia and a preview of Twitch Integration!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

First off, [b]Trivia Tuesday is moving![/b] Following player feedback and collected data we have decided to move the event to Saturday and will be henceforth known as 'Saturday Night Trivia'! We have also adjusted the achievements and cosmetic requirements to suit the new times. Don't worry if you have already completed these challenges - your progress has been retained!

The hour long window will remain at these same times only now on a Saturday:

[b]EU Friendly Time Slot[/b]
- [i]6pm - 7pm[/i] [b]UTC[/b] (Sat)
- [i]7pm - 8pm[/i] [b]BST[/b] (Sat)
- [i]2pm - 3pm[/i] [b]EST[/b] (Sat)
- [i]1pm - 2pm[/i] [b]CST[/b] (Sat)
- [i]11am - 12pm[/i] [b]PST[/b] (Sat)

[b]US Friendly Time Slot[/b]
- [i]1am - 2am[/i] [b]UTC[/b] (Sun)
- [i]2am - 3am[/i] [b]BST[/b] (Sun)
- [i]9pm - 10pm[/i] [b]EST[/b] (Sat)
- [i]8pm - 9pm[/i] [b]CST[/b] (Sat)
- [i]6pm - 7pm[/i] [b]PST[/b] (Sat)

Development on [b]Twitch integration is progressing smoothly and will be arriving soon in a playable Beta.[/b] While it is not dropping this patch we want to give a quick rundown of what we have so far. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/a7V6Ytq.png[/img]

Connecting Twitch chat as a player requires only the input of your Twitch account name and a name for your community to play under. No stream keys are needed!

Your community can play alongside you without owning the game simply by typing A, B, C, or D in the chat.  When an answer is revealed a breakdown of how your chat voted for that question will also be shown. Points are awarded to the Twitch character proportionally for how many of your Twitch viewers selected the correct answer. This Twitch player can be added to any game mode, so you can compete or work together and take down bosses!

During our Beta we will be looking into adding additional customization, settings and rulesets that will ensure that playing with your Twitch community is as smooth as possible. As always, we are looking for feedback and suggestions to help shape this new feature! Let us know what you think on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb][b]Discord![/b][/url]

In the coming weeks are are continuing development on our next milestone feature: Twitch Integration! Currently [b]we're focused on creating a seamless experience when playing with your Twitch community easily through chat.[/b] Look forward to future updates including a Beta of this feature soon!

notes.title: Room Codes! Joining Games has Never Been Easier!
notes.content:
Hello Trivia-heads!

This regular update was focused on on finding more convenient ways for lobbies to get populated! After some experiments, we've settled on adding room codes in addition to the current join methods!

Players told us that invites being limited to Steam friends was inconvenient for both Discord groups and streamers. In response to this we have now added room codes! We hope this new join option will help you find additional convenient options to play with friends, fans and randoms.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rlEO8JA.png[/img]

Here's the full patch notes for Trivia Tricks version 0.8.17.1

[h3]Room Codes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Games can now be joined through room codes!
[*] Even private games can be joined by room code! This means you can invite players without needing them on your Steam friends list
[*] A lobby's room code is visible in the Lobby Settings Menu and during gameplay in the Pause Menu
[*] Room codes are invisible unless they are being hovered by the mouse (or for gamepads, while right trigger is pressed). Handy for streamers!
[*] The Server Menu has been updated to include a text box where you can enter room codes to join games!
[/list]

[h3]Question Database Update[/h3]
[list]
[*] Completing our focused efforts to improve the mathematics category, the incorrect answers to math questions will now be in a closer range to the right answer and feature options that players are likely to accidentally calculate. Keep your mental math sharp! The difficulty just went up!
[*] Added nearly 50 additional questions, the vast majority suggested by the [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord community![/url] Thank you to everyone who has suggested questions so far!
[*] Fixed some typos and cleaned up the wording on a variety of questions. Thanks to all of you who took the time to report these to us directly!
[/list]

[h3]Other Changes[/h3]
[list]

notes.title: See Who's Pulling Their Weight in Co-Op, Plus... Secret Codes?!
notes.content:
Hello Trivia-brains! Big update for y'all incoming!

First off, we’re introducing an easy-access leaderboard that can be reviewed even during the game to see how you’re doing against your fellow Tricksters! In Co-Op Vs Boss it even shows players how they’re placed in their particular teams to introduce some competitive flare.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/66e7gYH.png[/img]

Please let us know what you think of this layout, as we’re intending to replace the leaderboard Mr. Tricks displays on the TV with this new look. Additionally, this is laying the groundwork so we can use your saved character names when online (a much requested feature...). Stay tuned!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bw14Kut.png[/img]

Also – check out our new ‘Secret Codes’ field in the options menu. 👀 Many of our communities favorite cosmetics were those released during our limited-time Halloween and Christmas events. So, rather than make y’all wait over 200 days, we’ve started to add some inventive ways that these items can be unlocked out-of-season. Some will use secret codes that we’ll be revealing through [url=https://twitter.com/TriviaTricks][b]Twitter[/b][/url] and [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord[/url] while others may require you to think a little more ‘out there’. Keep those eyes peeled!

One last thing! After reviewing our player numbers we released an update last week which pulled back the US Trivia Tuesday time slot to an hour earlier. You can see the exact time both on the in-game counter in the main menu and on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1404090/discussions/0/2966146418270976282/]the discussion board.[/url] See you there!

Here's the full patch notes for Trivia Tricks version 0.8.16.3

[h3]Tab Menu[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a mid-game leaderboard that can be accessed by pressing Tab on a keyboard or pressing the Back/Select/View button on a controller!
[*] This menu will break down exact player scores in Co-Op Vs Boss mode, so you can review how every member of your team is doing
[*] Clicking on players' avatars in this menu will open their Steam Profile
[*] Hosts can also use this menu to kick players while the game is in progress
[*] Player rankings and positions are jumbled during the last round to avoid spoilers
[*] The Phone controller layout has been updated to include a Back/Select/View button, enabling the leaderboard to be opened by mobile players!
[*] We will be looking at updating the TV leaderboard in the future to match this new design, so please let us know what you think!
[/list]

[h3]Secret Codes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Misc window in the Settings menu has now has a text field to enter secret codes! 👀
[*] We will be periodically introducing methods to unlock our most popular limited-time cosmetics. Some will require codes we’ll be releasing on [url=https://twitter.com/TriviaTricks][b]Twitter[/b][/url] and [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord[/url]
[*] While others may require some community puzzle solving!
[*] Expert code-crackers have some unique sunglasses and an achievement already waiting for them. Good luck!
[/list]

[h3]Question Database Update[/h3]
[list]
[*] We continued our efforts to improve the mathematics category. We believe we’ve tracked down all of the extremely basic arithmetic questions. Next update we will be adjusting the incorrect answers to the remaining questions to make them likelier to trip players up!
[*] Added nearly 50 additional questions, the vast majority suggested by the [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord community![/url] Thank you to everyone who has suggested questions so far!
[*] Fixed some typos, and cleaned up the wording on a variety of questions. Thanks to all of you who took the time to report these to us directly!
[/list]

[h3]Other Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The April Fools' joke Loot Box cosmetic has had its icon and description updated in the Character Creator and is no longer obtained on startup. It will be made available again in the future!
[*] Clicking a player's avatar in the lobby will now open their Steam profile
[*] The current round number and total rounds are now displayed on the TV
[*] The controls menu has been updated to include an image showing the layout for phone players
[*] In the host menu the button command explaining how to change tab was a little difficult to see, so we’ve placed a background behind it to improve visibility
[*] Player names can no longer contain characters like !, . or ?
[*] Improved the laugh emotion to fade instead of dissolve
[*] From extremely impassioned feedback by many-a-wronged player, we have decided chance round cannot ever be "Fair" and have instead renamed that option to "Tame"
[*] Does playing Trivia Tricks ever make you feel like you’re being watched?
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where, after joining a game which was already in progress, players would have to click their answer twice after sending a chat message
[*] The ‘Lucky Kitty’ and ‘Unlucky Kitty’ achievements will now unlock when the winner is revealed, rather than as soon as the game ends
[*] Fixed a bug where the ‘Sticking To Your Guns’, ‘Honk!’ and ‘Tuesday Tussle’ achievements were not being granted on game boot if the player had the associated cosmetic but not the achievement
[*] Fixed a bug where, after a game against King, the wrong camera was used in the lobby
[*] Fixed a bug where P2/P3/P4 could not interact with all elements in the Pause menu
[*] Fixed a bug in the Character Select screen where, after joining with keyboard for player 2, the button command to join player 1 would show the wrong button
[*] Fixed a bug in the Character Select screen where, after leaving a game with the keyboard, the command to open the Remote Play Help Menu would show the wrong button
[*] All 9 players will now be displayed if 8 players and the boss select the same answer. Previously the final player to answer would be cut off (although this did not impact scoring)
[*] Fixed an issue with the Controller Disconnected menu where it could disappear without resolving Player 1's disconnection if multiple players were disconnected at the same time
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could spam menu navigation sounds while the Controller Disconnected menu was visible
[*] Fixed a bug where pressing Tab on a keyboard could cause unusual interactions with UI elements in certain menus
[*] Potentially fixed the issue where P3 would sometimes be floating in the air at game start, or P5/6 would jitter up and down whenever the camera focused on the TV. However, this definitely isn’t our first attempt to solve this one, so no promises! 
[/list]

Please let us know what you think on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1404090/discussions/]Steam Discussion Forum[/url] or join our ever-growing [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord.[/url] Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!
