notes.title: Use Your Phone to Connect More Players in Trivia Tricks!
notes.content:
Hello Trivia Fans!

We would like to start by giving a shoutout to the particular brand of [i]Egg[/i]heads that have recently joined the show! Welcome aboard!

This week we've been improving the experience for Steam Remote Play Together users, [b]with a focus on enabling Trivia Tricks to be controlled through mobile phones.[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xZWRFsU.png[/img]

The latest update to Steam Remote Play has made it possible to turn any smartphone into a controller by simply following a link! Phones-as-controllers has been our most requested feature by far and this update is aimed at making the Remote Play experience as seamless as possible!

Your phones will automatically load our Steam Input layout and an in-game tutorial to set this all up is now on the Character Select Screen (really, it's easy!). The cherry on top of all these benefits - [b]with Remote Play you can play with others online who don't even own Trivia Tricks![/b] Nifty!

That's not all! We've also been busy fixing bugs (especially around the chatbox) and adding a heap of new questions on the latest hot topics as suggested by our extremely friendly [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb][b]Discord community![/b][/url]

Check out the full patch notes to Trivia Tricks 0.8.15.2 below!

[h3]Improvements for Remote Play[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Character Select Screen now contains a handy tutorial on how to get setup with Steam Remote Play, both for using phones as controllers and for playing online with a single copy of Trivia Tricks
[*] Mobile players will automatically get our mobile controller layout, designed to keep the questions and answers visible at all times
[*] The controller disconnection menu has been changed to a non-invasive notification which allows questions to still be answered while shown - with the option of swapping out the disconnected player for an AI. Previously this was a full-screen dialog box which could only be dismissed by reconnecting the controller or returning to the main menu. This is to better accommodate possible network dropouts.
[*] All players can now open and navigate the pause menu, not just player 1
[*] The Character Select Screen has had its icons updated to represent phone players
[*] The Character Creator now has a button to generate a random player name, allowing characters to be created without needing a keyboard (nifty for controllers!)
[/list]

[h3]Question Database Update[/h3]
[list]
[*] We have begun to adjust the focus of the mathematics category so there are less questions on basic arithmetics, therefore increasing the likelihood of getting a mathematics trivia question. We are also rebalancing the arithmetic questions to be generally harder. The benefits of this will become more visible over the next couple of updates!
[*] Added over 50 additional questions suggested by the [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord community![/url] Thank you to everyone who has suggested questions so far!
[*] Fixed some typos, and cleaned up the wording on a variety of questions. Thanks to all of you who took the time to report these to us directly!
[/list]

[h3]Chat Box Usability Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] The chat box and disconnection menu will now appear in the correct location for all aspect ratios
[*] Fixed a bug where all text typed into the character creator name field and chat box would be placed at the end, regardless of the cursor's position
[*] Fixed a bug where it was not possible to click in the chat box or scroll chat history while a question was being asked, or when a Trickster was speaking
[*] Fixed a bug where the chat would not wrap especially long words to a new line if they were too long
[/list]

[h3]Misc Bug Fixes![/h3]
[list]
[*] Achievements that require the player to win a game or beat a boss will now unlock when the final score is revealed instead of during the scene transition. No more spoilers!
[*] Achievements and cosmetics that must be unlocked in Standard Trivia mode now explicitly mention this in their descriptions
[*] We've told Negative to get a move on during his chance time, so his animations are a lot faster now!
[*] Fixed a bug where players who joined the lobby would be shown with the host's appearance until their cosmetics were loaded
[*] Fixed a bug where, when Change Answers was enabled, the player was sometimes able to answer during moments where there were no questions being asked
[*] Fixed an issue where the button prompts in the lobby didn't always show the correct icons for the currently used control method
[*] Fixed a bug where local players other than player 1 could swap tab in the lobby host screen
[*] Game start timer now remains in a X:XX format during the whole countdown
[*] Game timer will now display 'Now starting...' when all players have readied up instead of returning to 1:00
[*] Fixed bug where 'P' and 'Esc' had slightly different behaviour in certain pause screens
[*] Some UI elements have been repositioned so there's no longer a pixel gap at the edge of the screen
[/list]

Over the next couple of weeks we will be [b]improving the UI's integration with Steam Community features.[/b]

Please let us know what you think on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1404090/discussions/]Steam Discussion Forum[/url] or join our ever-growing [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord.[/url] Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

notes.title: Even More Options to Host Your Perfect Trivia Night!
notes.content:
Hello Trivia Fans!

For our twelfth regular update we have collected player feedback and [b]significantly expanded the rule customization options, alongside adding some extra achievements and cosmetics![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1MQvYu2.png[/img]

Players told us they wanted to be able to increase or decrease the question timer, change answers after selection, and to opt for a less (or more!) score impacting Chance Round. In order to implement these options we've redesigned the lobby hosting screen to suit the range of ruleset options now available. Please let us know what you think, and any more ideas on more gameplay customization tweaks you would like to see!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3ZBD5R7.png[/img]

The cherry on top of this update is three additional achievements, including one we reckon will be our hardest challenge yet! Good luck!!

The full changelist for Trivia Tricks version 0.8.14.0 is as follows...

[h3]More Game Customization![/h3]
[list]
[*] Hosts can now choose to allow players to change their answers after selection in Standard Trivia games
[*] Hosts can now also choose to allow everyone to see each other's answers during a Standard Trivia game. Please note however that AI answers will remain hidden!
[*] Chance Round odds can now be customized – alongside the existing ‘Off’ and ‘Normal’ we have also added ‘Fair’ and ‘Chaotic’!
[*] ‘Fair’ removes the 1.5x and 1/2 chance balls, especially useful in medium and long games!
[*] While ‘Chaotic’ significantly increases the chance of those multiplier balls appearing!
[/list]
[h3]New Lobby Menu![/h3]
[list]
[*] The Lobby menu has been redesigned to be clearer, and give us space for additional customization options in future!
[*] Modes and bonuses now have text to explain how they impact gameplay.
[*] Bosses now little personality biographies and a star rating to represent their difficulty.
[*] The game start countdown timer for when most of a lobby has readied up is now closer to the 'Ready' button and always visible.
[/list]
[h3]Three New Achievements![/h3]
[list]
[*] Even more achievements, which unlock even more cosmetics!
[*] Sticking to Your Guns
- To unlock, be the only player to get an answer right in a Co-Op game with 4 or more players!
- This unlocks the [b]Cowboy Hat![/b]
[*] Tuesday Tussle
- To unlock, Beat a Boss in Co-Op during Trivia Tuesday!
- This unlocks the [b]Steampunk Shirt![/b]
[*] HONK!
- To unlock, get every question wrong in an entire Standard Trivia game!
- This unlocks the [b]Clown Wig![/b] (honk)
[/list]
[h3]General Experience Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] After selecting an answer that answer will become highlighted. This is turned off if more than one person is playing on your machine to prevent you from seeing each other's answers.
[*] There is now also a hover effect when mousing over answers.
[*] When playing a Vs Boss game, your Steam friends list will now show you as being in a 'Vs Boss' game rather than a 'Trivia' game.
[*] Screen transitions are now significantly more responsive.
[*] Loading times have been heavily reduced.
[*] When a player joins a game the unusual camera transition, and Trickster 90 degree spin, has been replaced with a more sensible smoke ‘pop’ effect.
[*] Increased Negative's difficulty - he's now smarter and can streak more consistently! This should put him more in line with the difficulty we were expecting to see.
[*] Achievements and cosmetics that must be unlocked in Standard Trivia mode now explicitly mention this in their descriptions.
[/list]
[h3]Question Database Update[/h3]
[list]
[*] Significantly expanded the question count of the Music and Sports categories!
[*] Added more questions to the Art/Literature, Film/TV and Video Game categories!
[*] Added many additional questions suggested by the [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord community![/url] Thank you to everyone who has suggested questions so far!
[*] Fixed some question typos, and cleaned up the wording on a variety of questions. Thank you to all of you who reported these to us directly!
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where players could change the number of rounds played when playing Vs Boss.
[*] Fixed a bug where if you joined midgame, and hadn't been in that game before, you started with 0 points instead of the points of the lowest player.
[*] Fixed a bug where if you joined midgame, and it was a Standard Trivia game with Chance Round enabled, the Chance Round's ball machine would be invisible.
[*] Fixed a bug where if you joined midgame, and then left while joining, the AI would be stuck facing sideways for the rest of the game.
[*] Fixed a bug where if you joined midgame, and there was more than one player on your machine, then left then rejoined, you would not take over your previous characters.
[*] Fixed a bug where if you joined midgame, the question timer would shake for 3 seconds when asked the next question.
[*] Fixed a bug where if you joined a game with more than one player on your machine, the game would spawn a chat per player on your machine, when only one should be required.
[/list]

Over the next two of weeks we will be improving the experience for [b]Steam Remote Play Together players, with a focus on making Trivia Tricks more accessible for mobile phones.[/b]

Please let us know what you think on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1404090/discussions/]Steam Discussion Forum[/url] or join our ever-growing [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord.[/url] Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

notes.title: Meet our newest Boss: Negative! Plus, join games that are in progress!
notes.content:
Hey!

Substantial update this week trivia heads! Headliners are [b]a whole new Boss and functionality to join games that have already began![/b]

First, that new Boss to clash against in Co-Op Vs Boss mode. Everybody, meet Negative!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TwjbutF.gif[/img]

Negative's for those among you who were looking for a Boss that's a bit more difficult than King. Not only does Negative create his own score damaging chance round balls, he will take points away from players who pick a wrong answer! Negative's not impossible though, as you're able to veto a large number of categories against him. Pull together your hot shot Trivia team, focus your expertise, and earn the Shirt of Shadows!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ke28QsU.gif[/img]

Additionally, you can now join games that are in-progress! Had a temporary internet blip? Rejoin with the points you left off with! Seeing a game in progress? We'll bump your score up to a fighting chance!

Regular update #11 is topped off with the script doubling in size, dozens of new questions from our friends in [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord[/url], re-balanced Boss AI behaviour and a huge list of squashed bugs! We're sure you'll agree this is one of our biggest updates yet.

For those of you interested in the nitty-gritty, you can find the extensive patch notes to Trivia Tricks version 0.8.13.3 below:

[h3]Meet Negative![/h3]
[list]
[*] Team up to take down the edgiest of anti-heroes, Negative!
[*] Careful now! You'll lose points for wrong answers...
[*] And good luck enduring those damaging Chance Rounds...
[*] But you can veto significantly more categories against Negative, so narrow the playing field to the subjects you're strongest at!
[*] Beat Negative to unlock the new achievement, 'Negative Attitude', and earn the right to wear the spooky Shirt of Shadows!
[*] Negative is topped off with a new model, animations, script, and voice! Good luck!
[/list]
[h3]Joining Games that are In Progress![/h3]
[list]
[*] It is now possible to join games online after they have started!
[*] If you have left or been disconnected from a game you will rejoin as your previous character with your old points, plus any that the AI has accumulated in the time since rejoining
[*] If you're joining a Trivia game you haven't previously been in, we'll give you points that match the score of the lowest human player to get you caught up
[*] If you join a Boss Mode that's in progress, you will inherit the points of the AI character that you replace
[*] There is an informational screen when joining in-progress games, letting you know what question and round the game is currently on
[*] Added an 'Invite Friends' button to the Pause Menu when online, handy if you're hosting an invite-only game!
[*] The chat will keep you updated with the joining progress of any connecting players
[*] Online games can be joined as long as there is an AI slot in the game that can be filled; so if you want players to be able to join you after the game has started, make sure there's a few AI available!
[*] The join message when a game is full has been updated to explain that the player may not be able to join as there may be no AI slots to take the place of
[*] In the case that a player has left, and a different player joins, they will only take the previously disconnected players slot if there is no other AI to join over
[*] We hope that these changes make it easier for you to find games to play, and allow those of you who get disconnected mid-game to rejoin! Please let us know what you think!
[/list]
[h3]Server Menu Changes![/h3]
[list]
[*] The server menu information has also been updated to give more useful information on games that have begun
[*] In-progress games are shown with an animated background
[*] The lobby screen now shows which round the game is currently in, and how many there are to go
[*] Lobbies now show if they're playing Standard Trivia or Co-Op Vs Boss
[/list]
[h3] Boss AI Redesign![/h3]
[list]
[*] The AI for Bosses is significantly more advanced than before and tracks various statistics to provide a more balanced and consistent experience
[*] These changes should stop a Boss' score from becoming unachievably high
[*] And they should stop a Boss' score from being uncharacteristically low
[*] Bosses are now smarter at their favorite categories! For example, King is now more knowledgeable when it comes to History!
[*] We'll be listening closely to your feedback on this Boss AI and will continue to adjust the balance in future patches, with a goal of giving this level of customization to our regular Trivia CPU characters!
[/list]
[h3]Question Database Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed many question typos, and cleaned up the wording on a variety of questions. Thank you to all of you who reported these to us directly!
[*] Added many additional questions suggested by the [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord community![/url] Thank you to everyone who has suggested questions so far!
[/list]
[h3]Other Changes & Squashed Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Trivia Tricks script has doubled in size! You'll find a lot more variety whenever Mr Tricks speaks!
[*] In addition, Bosses can have more than one line, and as such King's script has been heavily expanded!
[*] The lobby text in Boss Mode now updates to explain a Boss' unique mechanics
[*] Fixed a bug where the camera would not zoom into the TV if a player selected an answer at the very last moment
[*] Fixed a bug where the incorrect camera was used when revealing the answers in offline mode
[*] Fixed a bug where the player count would not update in the server browser if a player left during the game
[*] Fixed a bug where the Boss would appear as blue in the TV leaderboard, rather than using their personal banner (for example, King's banner should be gold)
[*] Fixed a bug where Bosses would still pick the correct answer 25% of the time when their intention was to pick an incorrect answer
[*] Fixed an issue where lighting was being applied incorrectly to the Chance Round Ball Machine
[*] Fixed a recent regression where lighting was being applied incorrectly to the Tricksters
[*] Fixed the community question credit text displaying long names incorrectly
[/list]

Over the next two weeks we will be focusing on redesigning the lobby menu, allowing us to add additional rule customization options. We'll also be adding some extra achievements and cosmetics! You might be wondering why Negative is so grumpy? Well, he was going to have a starring role in a cancelled game, so maybe he still has a bit of a grudge?!

Please let us know what you think on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1404090/discussions/]Steam Discussion Forum[/url] or join our ever-growing [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord.[/url] Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

notes.title: Better Questions, Faster Boss Rounds, Bugs Squashed!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

This week our goal was general polish and bug fixes based on community feedback. Therefore, we focused these efforts on [b]improving the quality of our questions and the pacing of boss mode.[/b] In addition we put aside time to squash the most commonly encountered and more severe outstanding bugs. Most of this feedback was brought to our attention through our Discord community and watching your streams  - so thanks to all of you for helping to improve the game!

You can find the specific patch notes to Trivia Tricks version 0.8.11.0 below:

[h3]Question Database Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Nearly 300 questions have been adjusted in this update.
[*]Re-vetted all user submitted questions and removed those on obscure topics.
[*]All categories have been assessed for questions with a predominant focus on British culture, with any such questions being removed. Particular attention was paid to the Sport, History and Film/TV categories.
[*]Standardized on American spelling.
[*]If you feel a question is too hard, or notice a mistake, [url=https://discord.gg/jqCNsDYWs9]we now have a new Discord channel specifically for question feedback![/url] Come join in the discussions and get your suggestions in future updates!
[/list]
[h3]Vs Boss Mode Pacing Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Sped up Chance Round during Vs Boss mode – non-multiplier balls now move to players much faster.
[/list]
[h3]Server Menu & Lobby Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Trying to enter an un-joinable lobby (Such as one that is full) will now inform the player why they cannot join it.
[*]Additional messaging informing players why their attempt to join a lobby failed (such as in the case of a failed connection).
[*]Fixed guest local players not being counted in the online lobby player count.
[*]Fixed a bug where players couldn't see full lobbies in the Server Menu.
[*]Fixed a bug where players could attempt to join games that were in-progress.
[*]Fixed various bugs where it was possible to have more than 8 players spawn in a lobby.
[*]Fixed a bug where failing to join a lobby that was in-progress would prevent you from joining that lobby when it becomes available.
[*]Beta lobbies are now hidden from non-beta players.
[/list]
[h3]Bugs Squashed[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where player avatars were shown against the wrong players when someone left the lobby.
[*]Fixed a bug where the first leaderboard of a game would fill with '2222' (or the money awarded in the previous game) following a specific combination of players joining and leaving.
[*]Fixed a bug where a solo player using a gamepad was unable to use the mouse to answer questions.
[*]Fixed the 'Ready' countdown appearing in the lobby for a split second when everyone readied up.
[*]Fixed a rare bug where achievements for winning and losing games were not always being correctly awarded.
[*]Fixed text over-flow issues in a number of dialog boxes.
[*]Fixed a bug where the chance round balls would be untextured if they fail to load in time. They now display a placeholder texture.
[*] Fixed a bug where the leaderboard music would play during Chance Round before the balls are drawn in Vs Boss Mode
[*]Additionally, we released a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1404090/announcements/detail/3041586785465008726]a hotfix last Sunday[/url] which resolved an issue that, in extremely rare cases, could lead to save corruption.
[/list]
[h3]Other Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Correct answer on the TV screen now made clearer.
[*]In Vs Boss Mode AI answers are no longer displayed mid-question.
[*]The King now looks smug during Chance Round instead of angry.
[*]King-specific dialogue has been updated.
[*]The ‘Exclusive Fullscreen’ option has been removed. This option was misleading as it was not enabling ‘true’ exclusive fullscreen. We are still attempting to resolve the issues with exclusive fullscreen, and we apologise to our players for the confusion!
[*]Added decimal separators to the numbers in the Statistics Menu.
[/list]
Over the next two weeks we will be reimagining Vs Boss mode and introducing a new opponent!

Please let us know what you think on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1404090/discussions/]Steam Discussion Forum[/url] or join our ever-growing [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord.[/url] Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

notes.title: Trivia Tricks 0.8.10.2 (Save Game Issue Hotfix)
notes.content:
We recently received notice of an extremely limited number of players (currently 2) losing their save data. We've worked with the players affected to restore their saves and investigate the root cause, resulting in this hotfix release we believe will stop this issue from occurring.

Our findings suggest this has impacted an extremely small subset of our playerbase. If you have been affected please get in touch either [url=https://discord.gg/uXydkEkB]through our Discord[/url] in the #ideas-and-feedback channel or as a reply to this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1404090/discussions/0/3111392579693299532/]dedicated Steam thread[/url]. A member of the development team will then be in-touch to restore your progress ASAP.

Here are the patch notes to Trivia Tricks version 0.8.10.2

[list]
[*] In the case a save attempt is attempted to be made, but the players save has yet to be loaded, the game will not save
[*] If Trivia Tricks detects an empty or corrupted save on first load, the save will be removed and replaced with a standard, default save
[*] The in-game version number has been incremented
[/list]

Once again, we are extremely sorry to any folks this bug impacted. In addition to making our save game code more robust we're now in the process of designing a save backup feature.

notes.title: Changes to Vs Boss Mode: Team Communication!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're back this week with our eighth regular update! This week we were [b]implementing changes to Co-Op Vs Boss mode to make it easier to communicate as a team![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XJHVPSx.png[/img]

With this update comes a solution to make communicating with your team in Co-Op Vs Boss mode as easy as can be. [b]We've added notches to the answers on screen to show who has selected an answer[/b]. You can also now [b]change your answer as many times as you like[/b]. Pull the trigger too early on a guess but your friend actually watched that film? Now you can easily switch and earn your team some points. We hope this makes it easier for everyone to work together and help your attempts in taking on The King!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/a9MxYaG.png[/img]

Coming to the character creator this week is also a new shirt with a cute little snake on it. This shirt is dedicated to 'Fangs' - a friend's snake who sadly is no longer with us but will be remembered fondly.

There are also some improvements this week to game lobbies based on feedback from the community and watching our lovely streamers.

You can find the patch notes to Trivia Tricks version 0.8.10.0 below:

[h3]Visible and Changing Answers![/h3]
[list]
[*]Answers are now made visible via notches in Co-Op Vs Boss mode to help communicate as a team.
[*] You can now change your answer as many times as you like when playing in Co-Op Vs Boss mode.
[/list]
[h3]Lobby Improvements![/h3]
[list]
[*] As the host of a lobby you can now kick players.
[*] When 60% of players ready up the game will now count down 60 seconds before automatically starting.
[/list]
[h3]Misc Changes![/h3]
[list]
[*] When playing online with a guest, they will now use the name of their selected character, and not the Steam accounts' name. (Example: 'Mr. Tricks (1)' will now be known as 'Trinity').
[*] After answering players can now use the answer buttons/keys to emote faster. (Please note that you cannot use emotes in Co-Op Vs Boss because you will change your answer!)
[*]A new free shirt is available for all players, the Fangs shirt!
[*]Pressing Start in the Character Select Screen will now also join a player.
[*] Added community written questions submitted via Discord.
[*] Updated our question database to fix a range of typos and issues.
[/list]
[h3]Bugs Squashed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where clicking to leave a game sometimes would not work depending on mouse placement when the menu opened.
[*] Fixed an issue where clicking to answer a question sometimes would not work depending on mouse placement when the buttons appeared.
[*] Fixed guest podium names displaying a different player's name when playing online with a guest.
[/list]

Next week we will be focusing on general fixes and polish in a number of areas based off of community feedback.

Please let us know what you think on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1404090/discussions/]Steam Discussion Forum[/url] or join our ever-growing [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord.[/url] Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

notes.title: The Return of Boss Mode! Plus, Trivia Tricks is now DRM-Free!
notes.content:
Hello Trivia fans!

Welcome to our seventh regular update! This week we were [b]reimplementing the Vs Boss mode, alongside making Trivia Tricks DRM-free![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sOU7iG6.jpeg[/img]

Firstly, meet [b]The King[/b], our first boss, promoted from humble easter egg to star egghead! It’ll take a real team effort to get a win over him! Unlike our Festive bosses you can customize the categories you want to play when facing him, but he’ll refuse to budge on the royalty-filled History category! If your teamwork is able to dethrone King, you’ll be the rightful heir to his crown. Plus, if you’re the MVP at the end of that game, you’ll unlock a super-cool Headband available in several colours! Can you be the best on your team? Sure-you-can!!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PAlQKZU.jpg[/img]

During our decoupling of the Vs Boss Mode from its festive origins we’ve taken the time to ensure new bosses can be added much more quickly going forward. Got a great idea for a boss? Let us know! You may just find them behind a podium in a future update!

Next up, Trivia Tricks is now DRM free! We believe in free (as in freedom) software. We do not want to inconvenience our customers who may be offline for some time, or wish to easily move the game from one PC to another.  We set ourselves a goal to ensure that everything that SHOULD be possible without a connection to Steam is, and you can find the fruits of those efforts in the patch notes below! (Psst, did you know Trivia Tricks is Linux compatible through Proton? Nifty!)

To round this update out, we have applied a number of long-standing bug fixes, and thank you for your patience while we address these alongside our feature pushes!

You can find the patch notes to Trivia Tricks version 0.8.9.1 below:

[h3]Here comes The King![/h3]
[list]
[*] The King is our first co-op boss!
[*] The 'Vs Boss' button has returned, and is more clearly labelled as a co-op mode
[*] The King, and all future bosses, can now have their own podium design
[*] The King, and all future bosses, can now have their own backdrop on the TV when answers are displayed
[*] Players can now customize the categories against a boss
[*] Each boss can have their own custom veto allowance
[*] Bosses can also force specific categories on, in the case of the King, that’s History!
[*] The previous achievement for winning a game against the King Easter Egg has been migrated to an achievement for beating the King in co-op mode
[*] The previous King Easter Egg has been removed
[/list]

[h3]Trivia Tricks Goes DRM Free[/h3]
[list]
[*] Trivia Tricks is now DRM free, meaning it no longer requires Steam to play!
[*] Not all functionality will be possible when running Trivia Tricks without Steam, such as online play or Steam Input. In these cases we commit to giving ‘the best experience we can’
[*] Give a user-friendly error when player attempts to go online without a connection to Steam, explaining how the issue can be resolved
[*] Although Steam Input will not function when running Trivia Tricks without Steam, XInput controllers (Such as Xbox) will still work out-of-the-box
[*] When Steam cannot be reached, we now display a placeholder avatar (This may also resolve some crashes!)
[*] All achievements earned in your save file which hadn't been unlocked on your Steam profile will now automatically unlock on game load (Previously this was only implemented for the achievements that could be tracked through the statistics menu)
[/list]

[h3]AI Experience Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lobbies are automatically set to fill with 7 AI
[*] Lobbies will automatically fill with the number of AI that were present in the previously played game
[*] Alongside the keyboard/controller input to add AI, we have also added clickable buttons
[/list]

[h3]Other Experience Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] As we have increased our question count in recent updates, we have proportionally increased the number of vetoes players have when customizing their categories from 6 to 7!
[*] Short/Medium/Long games now are now labelled with how long they typically are to play
[*] Updated our questions database, fixing many question typos (Thanks to all of you for reporting these!)
[/list]

[h3]Bugs Squashed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Mr. Tricks was calling himself 'Elf Tricks' during Trivia Tuesday
[*] Fixed an issue where failing to host a game (Such as no internet connection) would cause Trivia Tricks to soft lock
[*] Fixed an issue where the Chance Round Machine could sometimes be visible when it was not intended to be in Vs Boss Mode
[*] Fixed an issue where Festive currency was still showing in the character creator, despite being unusable
[*] Fixed a bug where pressing 'ready' multiple times after accepting an invite would fail to join the game
[*] Fixed a bug where Mr Tricks was not using the provided animations, provided display image, or properly smiling/frowning for the dialogue for commenting on players' performances when the leaderboard is shown
[*] Fixed a bug where players would keep their streak if they did not answer a question
[*] Fixed a bug where empty podiums would sometimes display the name of the previous player that used them
[*] Fixed a bug where MVPs were not tracked correctly for the host
[*] Trivia Tricks is setup to not repeat the questions players have already seen. We're afraid that an issue occurred during our migration of questions out of the temporary 'Festive' category into their suitable, permanent categories. This means repeats of questions that you saw in the 'Festive' category may occur a single time. It will not be possible to retroactively correct this data. We're sincerely sorry for this inconvenience, and are already taking steps to ensure this does not happen for any future question migrations!
[/list]

Please let us know what you think on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1404090/discussions/]Steam Discussion Forum[/url] or join our ever-growing [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord[/url] and be the first to see when Question Bot is live! Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

notes.title: More Questions, Bug Fixes and the Future of Boss Mode!
notes.content:
Hey everybody! We hope you all had a lovely festive period and are staying safe this winter!

For our 6th regular update [b]we have concluded our Trivia Snowdown winter event[/b] and must sadly say goodbye to our Vs Boss mode - but not for long! Due to the exceptionally positive feedback the mode has received we have decided to make it a permanent feature, and [b]we will be reimplementing the Vs Boss mode over the next week, alongside making Trivia Tricks DRM-free![/b]

Thank you to everybody who took part in the event and for all the helpful feedback kindly given to create a better co-op experience. Over the next couple of releases we will be looking into:

[list]
[*] Better ways to communicate and share what you think is the correct answer with the lobby without having to use the chat box. 
[*] Being free to veto categories against a Boss character.
[*] Making Boss characters more lively with a bit more personality.
[*] AI balancing and difficulty adjustments.
[*] Adding Achievements and cosmetics to reward beating Bosses.
[*] Other, smaller design feedback we have received in testing.
[/list]

These changes and updates will be delivered regularly to meet [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1404090/announcements/detail/2905343385997561574]our first goal on our roadmap towards leaving early access.[/url]

The full patch notes of this update are below, update 0.8.8.0!

[h3]The Trivia Snowdown event is over![/h3]
[list]
[*] The Festive category has been removed and questions migrated where suitable
[*] The Festive items have been removed from the shop for players that did not buy or earn them. Feel you missed out? Don't worry! There's always next year!
[*] The stage has been reverted to a pre-Festive state
[*] Players will no longer earn cookies after a game
[*] The Vs Boss mode has been temporarily hidden while we unbuckle it from the holidays
[*] The game will no longer wish players happy holidays on boot, but everybody still gets their Santa Hats!
[*] Once again, thank you for your feedback during this time and helping shape Trivia Tricks!
[/list]

[h3]Question Database Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] The The following categories have been significantly expanded for questions - Anime, Art & Literature, Film & TV, Language, Music, Science, and Video Games
[*] The following categories feature additional questions - Animals, Food & Drink, Geography, History, and Sports
[*] Fixed many question typos (Thank you to all of you for reporting these!)
[*] We would like to thank the Discord community for their question suggestions over the last week and you can now find these questions in-game!
[/list]

[h3] Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in the lobby settings where the lobby rules could be adjusted as the game was starting
[*] Fixed an issue in the lobby settings where the ‘Streak’ text did not highlight when hovered
[*] Fixed an issue in the lobby settings where the tickboxes were not highlighting on hover in all appropriate states
[/list]

Please let us know what you think on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1404090/discussions/]Steam Discussion Forum[/url] or join our ever-growing [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord[/url] and be the first to see when Question Bot is live! Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

notes.title: New Year, New Questions! Plus, Question Bot Sneak Peak!
notes.content:
Hello Trivia Fans and [i]happy new year![/i]

Our fifth regular update just dropped which adds [b]several hundred questions, taking the Trivia Tricks total to over 4,500![/b] We have also improved our internal process for vetting new question additions, so you should notice a quality improvement going forward!

We have been closely observing player feedback on Trivia Snowdown's temporary 'Vs Boss' mode and we'll be making our design takeaways from this experiment public next week. One bit of feedback we've already taken into account with todays update - [b]the difficulty of both Santa and Krampus has been reduced![/b] So if you felt they were a little bit too hard before then now's the time to give it another shot! Remember, [b]you have until the 7th January to collect all the festive cosmetics[/b] and that includes the Santa's Suit and Krampus' Horns!

[h2]Sneak Peak, Question Bot's Around the Corner![/h2]

We believe the best way of ensuring a diverse question database is by collecting input from as many members of our community as possible. You may recall us mentioning that we had been investigating methods to ensure our question database can be driven by our users. [b]After experimenting, we've concluded the best means of achieving this would be a Question Bot in our Discord.[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WG0fO2O.png[/img]

Question Bot will be your one hub for question suggestion, and will even let you know if they've been approved for inclusion in Trivia Tricks! As an extra bonus, your name will be shown in-game alongside your question!

Question Bot needs a little more time in the oven, but we're hoping he'll be available to you all in the next couple of weeks. You may have already noticed the in-game pointers we added in preparation for the big launch!

To be clear, this doesn't impact our Early Access Milestone of Workshop support. We're committed to having Trivia Tricks' content be community-led and Workshop support is a core component of that goal.

Here's the full patch notes for this update, version 8.7.0!

[h3]Question Count Boost![/h3]
[list]
[*] The following categories have been heavily expanded, in some cases they're now over 20% larger!
- Food & Drink
- Film & TV
- Music
[*] The following categories also feature additional questions
- Animals
- Art & Literature
- History
- Language
- Science
- Sports
- Video Games
[*] Fixed many question typos (Thank you to all of you for reporting these!)
[/list]

[h3]Trivia Snowdown Adjustments![/h3]
[list]
[*] We have increased the base chance of Santa and Krampus getting a question wrong
[/list]

Please let us know what you think on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1404090/discussions/]Steam Discussion Forum[/url] or join our ever-growing [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord[/url] and be the first to see when Question Bot is live! Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

notes.title: Trivia Tricks: Trivia Snowdown!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kV8Ye9v.png[/img]

Hey everyone, it's me Mr. Tricks!

Trivia Tricks is getting in the holiday spirit with a limited time co-op trivia game mode! Do you and your friends know more about the holidays than the big man himself? Team up, take him on, and win cookies to spend on festive cosmetics!

We've also got a new 'Festive' trivia category, and of course a stage (And host!) makeover! Make sure to spend those cookies as soon as you can, as the event will be ending on the [b]7th January![/b]

See you on stage!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404090/Trivia_Tricks/

The backstage crew has been hard at work responding to all your feedback! If you're interested in the details the full patch notes are below!

[h3]Trivia Tricks Version 0.8.6.0[/h3]
[h3]Trivia Tricks: Trivia Snowdown![/h3]
[list]
[*] New Trivia Tricks Trivia Snowdown Event
- Added new 'Vs. Boss' mode!
- Team up with up to 7 others to take on Santa and Krampus
- Santa's a jolly guy and just can't help but give gifts during chance round...
- but don't expect the same generosity from Krampus!
- When against Santa or Krampus most questions will be from the 'Festive' category
- The team gets named after the player with the most points, the MVP!
- You'll find a new page in the  statistics menu to track your 'Vs Boss' stats, like 'Wins' and 'MVPs’!
- Beat Santa to get his world-renowned suit, beat Krampus and earn those sick horns!
- But hurry! You've only got until the [b]7th January![/b]

[*] New Currency... Cookies!
- Added new 'Festive' cosmetics, purchased with cookies!
- You'll earn more cookies per game the more human players you have on your team
- Careful! Santa and Krampus play better the more human players they're against! Communicate!
- Cookies are awarded at the end of regular Trivia games too; more players beaten = more cookies
- Trivia Tuesday [i]will[/i] give DOUBLE COOKIES for both boss and non-boss modes! Yummy!
- Purchased and earned cosmetics will be available for use after the event is over

[*] Added new, free forever, cosmetic... Santa's Hat!

[*] Decked the stage with a new festive look, and say hello to the new host, Elf Tricks!

[*] Question Database Updates
- Added the 'Festive' Category, featuring nearly 200 questions
- Expanded the 'Anime', 'History' and 'Film & TV' categories based on player feedback
- Removed questions on the 2 times table from the maths category
- Fixed many, many question typos (Thank you to all of you for reporting these!)

[*] Social Media Button Redeisgn
- Adjusted the design of the social media buttons on the main menu
- Social media buttons are now accessible with both keyboard and controller
- Discord link now mentions submitting your own questions, [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1404090]follow the Trivia Tricks Steam Group[/url][/b] for some exciting news about user-submitted questions coming soon!

[*] Other Changes + Bug Fixes
- Reworded the title on the Character Select Screen
- Fixed 'Standard' ruleset games being mislabelled as 'Basic' ruleset in the server browser
- Trivia Tuesday now requires a connection to Steam servers to actually start in-game, so no more changing your system clocks for double money! (We saw ya!!)
- Fixed an issue where the order the Chance Round balls were initially revealed would match the order that players joined chance round, making the result predictable
- Fixed case where 'Red Streaks Earned' and 'Blue Streaks Earned' stats were delayed in updating for non-hosts, making achievements like 'Warming Up' and 'Feeling The Heat' take an extra question to unlock
- Fixed the 'Big Brain' achievement not unlocking for non-hosts
- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1404090/view/5364315219798572102]We recently fixed an issue stopping Steam Cloud Saves from syncing[/url]
[/list]

[h3]A final note from the developers...[/h3]

The year's end is an appropriate time to reflect on what’s happened and to consider what's around the corner. We've been overwhelmed by the positive player reception we've been receiving and it has been less than 2 months since our Early Access release. We'd like to thank our community for their invaluable feedback, and we are humbled by our audience's growth showing consistent week-on-week momentum.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1404090/view/2933492783935921493][b]Our Halloween event[/b][/url] was put together in a restless period of just two days (!!), so Trivia Snowdown having two full weeks of development allowed us to be more ambitious. [b]The holidays are a time for banding together and we wanted to create an event in that spirit.[/b] Furthermore, it closely matches the goals of our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1404090/view/2905343385997561573][b]first Early Access milestone – full co-op Trivia.[/b][/url] Any feedback we receive on this ‘Vs Boss’ experiment will influence the direction we take ‘Co-op Trivia’, which will be in full development in the new year. Please let us know what you think.

We’re going to be taking a well-deserved rest, but that doesn’t mean we’re done! [b]Next week we’ll be dropping a big question count increase to all categories.[/b] Stay tuned!

As always, the best way to get in touch is through our [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord![/url] Or you can leave a note on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1404090/discussions/0/]Steam Discussion Forum![/url] Thank you for following Trivia Tricks, and happy holidays!

notes.title: Character Select Screen Overhaul
notes.content:
Hi everybody!

Below you will find details of our third weekly update. [b]This week we focused on addressing feedback from our player base regarding usability issues within the Character Select Screen.[/b] While Trivia Tricks has extremely flexible play options our playtests and analytics showed us that players were finding the Character Select Screen confusing to navigate. Now, we've redesigned the Character Select screen with a focus on clarity. Hopefully functionality such as joining an online lobby with a local party or leveraging [url=https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay#together]Steam Remote Play Together[/url] to play online with a single purchase will be immediately obvious!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KARUE10.jpg[/img]

Over the next week we’re looking to ensure solo players are able to find games online while our community is still growing. Stay tuned!

[h3]Character Select Redesign![/h3]
[list]
[*] The character select screen has been totally overhauled!
[*] Instead of selecting characters in an 8x2 grid, characters are now selected through a carousel
[*] The control options available for the remaining player slots are now clearly displayed
[*] On a controller the 'A' button is now be used to join the session instead of the 'Start' button
[*] 'Drop Out' no longer requires the player to hold the 'Back' or 'Del' key, just a tap will do
[*] The 'Ready' button prompt now displays what key to press to continue
[*] The same characters will be preselected upon leaving and re-entering the menu
[*] Many, many more improvements to readying up, un-readying, leaving this screen, connecting controllers, button prompt locations, dropping out... too much to list here!
[/list]

[h3]Updates to Question Database[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed case where maths questions with brackets requiring addition followed by subtraction would have an incorrect answer
[*] Removed extremely easy maths questions relating to the eleven times tables
[*] Fixed a number of typos in our questions (Thank you to all players who reported these!)
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed misspelling of the 'Cyclops' item in the Character Creator
[/list]

Please let us know what you think on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1404090/discussions/]Steam Discussion Forum[/url] or join our ever-growing [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord[/url]! Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

notes.title: Select Your Own Categories & No More Repeats!
notes.content:
Hi everybody!

Below you will find details of our second weekly update. [b]This week we focused on addressing feedback from our player base regarding category customisation and question repetition.[/b] Being able to adjust the category presets was our most requested feature and we subsequently made it our highest priority. We hope that following this update you’ll be able to customise Trivia Tricks to suit any player audience!

Additionally, Trivia Tricks now tracks which questions the player has seen to ensure minimal repeats. This system even mixes online players stats together, ensuring the questions are as new as possible for that particular lobby!

Over the next week we’re looking at improving the user interface for adding local players and selecting your character. Stay tuned!

[h3]Category Vetoing![/h3]
[list]
[*] Players can now veto up to 6 categories
[*] Playing with adjusted categories will label the lobby rules and category selection as ‘custom’ in the server browser
[*] The existing category presets have been adjusted to accommodate this change
[*] As more questions are added we will increase the number of categories players can veto proportionally!
[*] The preset categories still have the 25% chance reduction to select the maths category
[*] When categories are set to 'custom' however all categories will have an equal chance of being picked
[/list]

[h3]Improvements to Question Variety![/h3]
[list]
[*] Trivia Tricks will now track the questions a player has seen and how many times they have been seen it
[*] Trivia Tricks then prioritises showing you the questions you have seen the least
[*] In an online game all players seen questions stats will be combined, ensuring everybody is seeing as new content as possible to create a level playing field
[*] The seen questions are saved to the file located at [i]%LOCALAPPDATA%/TriviaTricks/Saved/SaveGames/QuestionCache.sav[/i]
[*] This will be synchronized through Steam Cloud
[*] This file can be deleted without impacting unlocked cosmetics and player stats (However you will see repeated questions!)
[*] Additionally it is no longer possible to get a question from the same category twice in a row
[/list]

[h3]Updates to Question Database[/h3]
[list]
[*] Heavily expanded the ‘History’ category to feature more questions on Eastern European history, ancient civilisations and the space race!
[*] Additional questions in the 'Anime' and 'Geography' categories
[*] Fixed a number of typos in our questions (Thank you to all players who reported these!)
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where using Q and E on the keyboard would skip over menu options in the Character Creator and Statistics Page if the player had interacted with the Character Select Screen within that session
[/list]

Please let us know what you think on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1404090/discussions/]Steam Discussion Forum[/url] or join our ever-growing [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord[/url]! Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

notes.title: New Cosmetics, Chat Improvements & More!
notes.content:
Hi everybody,

We hope you're all enjoying Trivia Tricks so far! Below you will find details of our first weekly update. [b]This week we focused on addressing feedback from our player base about some of the rougher patches in our user experience.[/b] We collected this feedback both from direct engagement with fans and observing play session footage. We hope that following this update Trivia Tricks will feel a much more polished experience!

Next weeks update will focus on improvements to Trivia Tricks’ questions, such as giving players better control of category selections and ensuring larger variety to the questions the game selects. Stay tuned!

[h3]Cosmetics[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added four new hats and two new shirt cosmetics to make your Trickster prettier than ever. Now available in the store!
[*] Were you jealous of Count Tricks cape? Don’t be! It's now permanently free for all players!
[/list]

[h3]General Usability Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a dialog message for clients when the host closes a game
[*] Servers will now accurately report player numbers when players join and leave the server
[*] FXAA x2 is now the default over FXAA x4
[/list]

[h3]Chat Experience Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where players would have to click their answer twice after typing into the chat (Keyboard and controller input were unaffected by this issue)
[*] Moved the question credit to the top right of the screen so it no longer covers chat
[*] Added a 200 character word limit to the chatbox
[*] Removed the right-click context menu from text entry boxes
[/list]

[h3]Updates to question database[/h3]
[list]
[*] Where appropriate, questions from the Halloween category have been migrated into suitable categories and reworded
[*] Expanded the ‘Food & Drink’ category to include questions about some ‘exotic’ tastes
[*] Fixed a number of maths number sequence questions having incorrect answers
[*] Removed yet more maths questions that had extremely easy answers
[*] Based on player feedback, maths questions are now 25% less likely than other categories
[*] Fixed a number of typos in our questions (Thank you to all players who reported these!)
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where Tricksters had a chance of floating over their podiums if you weren't playing with 4 or 8 Tricksters
[*] Fix bug where Character Select Screen would display visual glitches if the player had selected 2x FXAA in the options menu
[*] Upon failing to join a server players will now be directed back to the online character select screen instead of the offline character select screen
[*] Fixed controllers being able to open the ‘Invite Friends’ menu mid-game
[*] Fixed the ball machine textures being blurry on low-end machines
[*] Fixed the 'Failed To Join' dialog being difficult to dismiss with mouse
[*] Fixed the Character Select Screen accepting input during screen transitions
[*] Fixed the Character Select Screen accepting input during error dialogs
[*] Replaced the sound effect when trying to select an already-selected character from an embarrassing placeholder of myself making childish sounds to... something more sensible...
[*] The 'buy' sound in the store is now a more satisfying volume (Cha-ching!)
[/list]

[h3]Halloween event is over! Thank you for your feedback during this time![/h3]
[list]
[*] The Halloween category has been removed
[*] The Halloween items have been removed from the shop for players that did not buy them. Feel you missed out? Don't worry! There's always next year!
[*] The stage has been reverted to a pre-Halloween state
[*] Players will no longer earn candy after a game
[/list]

Please let us know what you think on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1404090/discussions/]Steam Discussion Forum[/url] or on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord[/url]! Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

notes.title: Trivia Tricks Halloween Event
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/CZM6OLc.png[/img]

Hey everyone, it's me Mr. Tricks!

Trivia Tricks is getting in the spooky spirit for Halloween!
Play any game of Trivia and earn candy to unlock special limited time cosmetics. I've got my own costume already picked out!

We also have a new Halloween category filled with terrifying questions on all things scary and supernatural! 

The event will be available to play until [b]November 5th[/b] so collect as much candy as you can!

See you on stage!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404090/Trivia_Tricks/

The backstage crew has been hard at work responding to all your feedback so far! If you're interested in the details the full patch notes are below!

[h3]Trivia Tricks Version 0.8.1.0[/h3]
[h3]Truly Terrifying Trivia![/h3]
[list]
[*] New Halloween Event
- Added new 'Halloween' Category, featuring 175 questions!
- Added new 'Halloween' Cosmetics, purchased with candy!]
- New spooky look for the stage and Mr. Tricks! 
- Candy is rewarded at the end of a Trivia game
- Cosmetics are available to purchase until 5th November
- Players will keep purchased cosmetics after the event is over

[*] Added new, free forever, eyelashes cosmetic!

[*] Question Database Updates
 - Added additional questions to 'Animal', 'Science', 'Sports' and 'Video Game' categories
 - Removed some maths questions that had extremely easy answers
 - Fixed some question typos (Thank you to all of you for reporting these!)

[*] General improvements to the text chat experience
- Chat window will now automatically scroll to the bottom when messages over two lines are sent
- Chat window will now display for 10 seconds instead of 5 seconds after a message is sent

[*] Fixed the ‘SELL! SELL! SELL!’ achievement not unlocking
 - This will automatically unlock on startup for any players who already met this condition

[*] All keyboard, mouse and controller inputs will now control the character if there is a single player on that system. We believe this will resolve reported issues of controller input not registering.
[*] Added a dialogue window to inform players when they fail to join a game
[*] Fixed a launch crash when Trivia Tricks was loaded in exclusive fullscreen while not being the focused window
[*] Fixed controller users being able to join games before the server search had completed
[*] Fixed a bug where unpausing the game while the ‘Are you sure you want to quit?’ dialog was shown would keep that dialog open
[*] Fixed the credits button and social media links not always registering input
[*] Fixed a typo in the statistics menu
[/list]

Please let us know what you think on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1404090/discussions/0/]Steam Discussion Forum[/url] or on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUwKvCb]Discord![/url] Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!
